title: A.R. Rahman’s son AR Ameen speaks after Chennai car accident, says family’s prayers “continue to guide and protect” him
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Taking to his Instagram Story, Ameen recalled the accident and shared he was travelling in the passenger seat of his friend's car when the incident took place while they were on their way to the airport.

Adding to this, He wrote, “Yesterday, on the way to the airport, I was in the passenger seat of my friend's car when we got into a minor accident. By God's grace, everyone involved is safe and okay. All praises to the Almighty (EPI) for His grace and protection over all of us (sic).”

Meanwhile, Ameen also acknowledged the messages and prayers he received from his family, friends and well-wishers following the accident. The singer expressed gratitude for the support and shared the incident had reinforced his belief in the values and guidance passed down to him by his family.

Notably, “It truly means more to me than I can express. I also believe that my grandma's, my dad's, and GV Anna's prayers and values continue to guide and protect me. I will always carry their teachings with me and strive to live by everything they have instilled in me. Thank you once again to everyone for your love, care, and support (sic),” Ameen wrote.

As per the latest buzz, The accident took place in Chennai in the early hours of Monday. According to the details available, Ameen and his friend were taken to a hospital after sustaining minor injuries. A passenger in the other vehicle involved in the collision was also as per reports injured. There have been no reports of life-threatening injuries among those involved.
In further updates, Ameen's latest update is likely to come as a relief to those who were concerned after news of the accident emerged.

title: Prakash Raj on his name being deleted from voter list amid SIR; says, “Game on”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bengaluru has emerged as the biggest concern in the state’s SIR exercise, with nearly half the city’s electors currently falling under the ASDDO (Absent, Shifted, Duplicate, Dead and Others) category during the house-to-house enumeration process.

Adding to this, In a video message on Instagram, Prakash Raj shared, “Dear friends, saathiyon, I want to share a joke with you, I am one of the 65 lakh voters whose voter right has been deleted from Bangalore constituency after SIR, nice joke, no. I was born in this constituency, I lived in this constituency, I had my schooling, college, theatre and for your kind information I was an MP candidate of this constituency, too. Well the joke is nice. Game on.”
Meanwhile, In the 2019 Lok Sabha polls, the star had contested as an Independent candidate from the Bangalore Central constituency.

Notably, Last month, Prakash Raj secured conditional bail after a city court in Bengaluru issued a non-bailable warrant against him in a case alleging that he possessed multiple voter ID cards. The complainant had alleged that the star possessed four voter ID cards, one each in Karnataka, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu, running afoul of the Election Commission’s rule permitting only one voter ID per person.

As per the latest buzz, He added, “Let me see what is the process I have to go through, kya kya kagaz dikhana padega (what all papers I have to show) to get back my voter ID,” in an apparent reference to the protests against the Citizenship Amendment Act, echoing screenwriter-lyricist Varun Grover’s protest poem “Hum Kaagaz Nahin Dikhayenge,” which became an anthem of resistance during the 2019 CAA-NRC protests.

In further updates, Signing off, Prakash Raj shared, “Well game on but one little word, my friend, you can use your powers to deny a few of the citizens the right to vote who may not elect you but can you stop us. My dear friend, from our power, we are bringing you down. Just asking. Bye.”

title: S&P 500 futures ticks higher as oil prices stabilize, Nvidia gains: Live updates
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

The S&P 500 moved lower on Tuesday as hopes among investors that the the Strait of Hormuz would reopen faltered, exacerbating lingering doubts that the U.S. and Iran can reach a broader resolution to the conflict.

Adding to this, The moves come as oil prices rose amid uncertainty over the Middle East conflict, with Iran reiterating that the strait would not reopen until its conditions have been met. U.S. West Texas Intermediate futures were last up 1% at above $83 a barrel. International benchmark Brent crude also gained 1% to above $88 a barrel.

Meanwhile, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi shared Sunday there was "no possibility of restarting negotiations" as long as the U.S. continues violating the June memorandum of understanding and does not compensate Iran for those violations, according to the semi-official Tasnim News Agency.

Notably, Investors will next turn to a key batch of inflation data, with the July consumer price report due Wednesday and the producer price index out Thursday. The readings could prove particularly important after a weak jobs report complicated the Fed's outlook.

As per the latest buzz, The inflation reports could put the Fed in a difficult position. Higher oil prices are renewing concerns about price pressures just as the sharp slowdown in hiring raises questions about the strength of consumer spending and the broader economy.

In further updates, "I expect the CPI report to continue its downward trend which will further support the case for the Federal Reserve to hold rates steady rather than hiking them, even with last Friday's weak jobs report," shared Dennis Follmer, chief investment officer at Montis Financial.

On top of that, "Services inflation could continue to be a sticky problem, but that sector is not very sensitive to interest rates, so it shouldn't really damage the case for holding steady," he added.

title: Mirzapur the Movie happened because of fan demand, says producer Farhan Akhtar about bringing the show to theatres
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mirzapur has been one of the most popular web shows in India since the streaming boom began in the country. The show, which began in 2018, has had three successful seasons. The impact and popularity of the series is such that it has become one of the few shows to be adapted for the big screen. The trailer of the Mirzapur the Movie was rolled out on Tuesday, and garnered a lot of reactions on social media.

Adding to this, Pankaj Tripathi will reprise his role as Kaleen Bhaiya in Mirzapur. What Farhan Akhtar shared Speaking at the trailer launch of Mirzapur: The Movie, producer Farhan Akhtar shared the enthusiasm of the followers across the world regarding the rollout date of the movie. He shared, “The show is a result of followers' love. They have supported the show from the time it was first rolled out. Amazon took it across the world. Wherever I used to go, people used to ask me, 'Ki Mirzapur kab aa rha hai?' When it was revealed, people used to ask me the rollout date, so it is really the followers that have demanded this movie. We are very happy and grateful to have put it together with the original cast and the amazing new cast.”

Meanwhile, He also shared a humorous anecdote when he first heard the story pitch of Puneet Krishna, saying that his first instinct was to refer the writer to a "brain doctor" as the story took them by surprise.

Notably, "When Puneet came to us for the first time, our first instinct was to refer him to a brain doctor. Then we thought of making it into a show so that people can get into it. Guru and Puneet are the heroes of the show. Ritesh, I, Excel Entertainment, and Amazon, we are really happy that we have been there to support them through this journey and work with them," shared Farhan Akhtar.

As per the latest buzz, The makers have rolled out the trailer of Mirzapur: The Movie, which continues from the world of Season 1, bringing together some of the franchise's most beloved and iconic characters, including Kaleen Bhaiya, Munna Bhaiya and Guddu Pandit. Pankaj Tripathi , Ali Fazal, Divyendu, and Rasika Dugal are all returning. The character of Bablu Pandit, originally played by Vikrant Massey in the series will be portrayed by Jitendra Kumar in the movie.

In further updates, At the centre of the new chapter is the race for the Gaddi, with new daawedaars entering the story and challenging the established power dynamics. As the battle gets bigger, the world of Mirzapur expands beyond Purvanchal, taking audiences into the deserts and an even more expansive cinematic landscape.

On top of that, The central tension of Mirzapur revolves around the clash between Kaleen Bhaiya, Munna Tripathi, and Guddu Pandit. As their rivalry escalates, politicians and rival gang members also become entangled in the power struggle. This fight to control Mirzapur forms the backbone of the story and leads to a continuous cycle of betrayal, violence and shifting power dynamics.

title: Shraddha Kapoor starrer Eetha gets new release date; Laxman Utekar directorial to hit theatres on December 4, 2026
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The Maddock Films production was earlier scheduled for an August 28 rollout and features Randeep Hooda and Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub.

Adding to this, Earlier, Eetha was scheduled to rollout on August 28. Bollywood Hungama was the first to reveal that the makers are keen on changing the rollout date of the movie. In July, in a report published by the portal, a source was quoted saying, “The producers – Maddock Films – are wondering whether to prepone the rollout or postpone. However, it is clear that they don’t plan to bring the movie on the original rollout date – August 28. In a few days, they are expected to make an official announcement on the change of rollout date.”

Meanwhile, Announcing the new date, the makers shared in a statement, ‘After the teaser broke all records, the team behind EETHA is back with great news for cinema lovers. Directed by Laxman Utekar, produced by Dinesh Vijan, Laxman Utekar and Karishma Sharma, with music by Ajay Atul, and starring Shraddha Kapoor and Randeep Hooda, Eetha promises to bring a spirited new story to the big screen this December. Paan mein paan chakhna ho toh meetha! Aur toofan ko nachte dekhna ho toh…EETHA!”

Notably, The makers further revealed, “Maddock Films and Kathputli Creations are all set for audiences to get ready for EETHA, as the much-awaited movie arrives on the big screen on December 4, 2026.”

As per the latest buzz, The movie is based on the life of Vithabai Narayangaonkar, a renowned Marathi Tamasha and Lavani performer who rose from humble beginnings to become one of Maharashtra's celebrated folk theatre artists. Fondly known as Eetha, her life and legacy form the central narrative of the movie. It is backed by Maddock Films and Kathputli Creations and features Shraddha as Eetha Bai alongside Randeep Hooda and Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub in pivotal roles.

In further updates, Eetha marks the first collaboration between Shraddha Kapoor and filmmaker Laxman Utekar. While both have been associated with successful projects under the Maddock Films banner, they have previously worked on separate films. The soon-to-release biographical drama brings them together for a story that takes Shraddha into a performance-driven role that is different from her work in Maddock's horror-comedy franchise.

On top of that, Adding to the movie's music lineup is the acclaimed composer duo Ajay-Atul, who have scored the movie. With its focus on the life of a prominent figure from Maharashtra's folk theatre tradition, Eetha is now gearing up for its December 4, 2026 theatrical rollout.

title: Himachal mindset of not wanting a girl child is worse than any other state in India, feels Kangana Ranaut
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star and BJP MP Kangana Ranaut ran away from her home in Himachal Pradesh as a teenager to fulfill her dreams. She tried her luck in becoming a model and then debuted as an star with Gangster in 2006. Over the years, Kangana has shared her views on several issues, be it nepotism in the movie industry or about her opinions as a newly elected MP from Mandi, Himachal Pradesh. In her latest post on X, Kangana has shared her feelings about the patriarchal mindset in Himachal where people are not happy when a girl child is born in the family after marriage.

Adding to this, BJP MP Kangana Ranaut during the ongoing Monsoon session of Parliament, in New Delh. (PTI Photo/Arun Sharma)(PTI08_03_2026_000150A) (PTI) What did Kangana say? In X, a user shared a video of a Himachali woman who gave birth 11 times after marriage. The first ten children were all girls and only the eleventh one was a boy. The user criticised this and wrote, 'Imagine making a woman go through pregnancy after pregnancy, basically her entire life, just because having 10 daughters still wasn’t enough. How badly do you have to dehumanise a woman to reduce her entire existence to one job: produce a son.'

Meanwhile, Kangana replied on this post and agreed to it, further adding, “In Himachal this mindset is worse than any other state I feel, I remember when one of my cousins had a second baby girl people poured in to their home for condolences , she called me and cried that relatives/people are coming to talk to her like someone has died she just can’t take it anymore, I was not shocked but helpless. One of my cousin’s wife was in depression because she had a second girl child, family and husband were very supportive but she didn’t want to see the baby’s face or touch her, it was so bad that she had to be admitted, now she is ok but it was beyond traumatic even for the older daughter, very sad situation out there.”

Notably, For the last few weeks, Kangana has been making headlines after sharing multiple posts against Gen Z and condemning the language used by some of the protesters. She sparked a major social media row by labelling certain young demonstrators as " Generation Gutter " and describing their widely shared protest clips as "puke-inducing." A few days ago, she took a U-turn and shared that the Gen Z are the country's strength.

As per the latest buzz, On the work front, Kangana Ranaut’s latest venture has been the movie Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata . Directed by Manoj Tapadia, the movie based on the true story of the nurses and staff at Cama Hospital who saved the lives of patients during the 2008 Mumbai terrorist attacks. It received an underwhelming response at the ticket-window is set to rollout on Zee5 on August 14.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Ram Gopal Varma’s Police Company full cast revealed; Director reunites with his Satya actors
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Now, Bollywood Hungama has learned that RGV has assembled an ensemble cast for the action crime drama. While Harshvardhan Rane will essay the role of Daya Nayak, sources say Fardeen Khan has been roped in to portray one of his colleagues and a key member of the specialised police squad at the heart of the narrative. Soundarya Sharma, previously seen in films like Meeruthiya Gangsters and Housefull 5 , will play the female lead opposite Rane. The director has also enlisted three of his favourite actors from his 1998 classic Satya , Paresh Rawal, Saurabh Shukla and Makarand Deshpande for pivotal supporting roles.

Adding to this, Produced by Bhushan Kumar’s T-Series and Ram Gopal Varma’s RGV Company Production, Police Company is a period crime thriller set against the backdrop of the late 1990s and early 2000s, a time when the underworld was rapidly expanding its grip across India. Between 1997 and 2004, a special squad described as being more dangerous than D Company was formed to counter the growing underworld threat and is believed to have eliminated nearly 300 gangsters. The movie draws inspiration from this turbulent chapter in Mumbai’s underworld history, with the story centred on Daya Nayak, who became one of the country’s most celebrated encounter specialists and held the fort against the underworld.
Meanwhile, The movie is set to go on floors next week, on August 17, in Mumbai, with plans to wrap production by December and rollout in theatres next year.

Notably, Police Company marks RGV’s return to gritty, hard-hitting cinema, blending his trademark realism with gripping action, edge-of-the-seat storytelling and the atmospheric tension that has become synonymous with his filmmaking. The story promises to explore the intensity, pressures and moral dilemmas that define a life spent on the frontlines of one of the world’s toughest cities. The director has been passionately working on the project and is set to present this extraordinary chapter of Mumbai’s crime history in the most authentic way possible.

title: Eetha release postponed: Shraddha Kapoor film on Vithabai Narayangaonkar avoids clash with Yash's Toxic
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Audiences will have to wait a little longer for Shraddha Kapoor 's Eetha. The movie, which was set to rollout in theatres on August 28, has now been postponed. The makers of the movie, Maddock Films , have officially opened up that the movie has been postponed from August to December. That means that Laxman Utekar's Eetha will no longer clash with Yash's pan-India rollout Toxic : A FairyTale for GrownUps.

Adding to this, Shraddha Kapoor in a still from Eetha. When will Eetha rollout? Eetha will now rollout in theatres on December 4. Maddock Films revealed the new rollout date with the caption, “TOOFAN ke liye taiyaar rehna... kyunki #EETHA aa rahi hai, 4th December ko (Get ready for the storm which will arrive with Eetha on December 4)!”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Maddock Films (@maddockfilms)

Notably, The teaser of Shraddha-starrer Eetha was rolled out on June, and attracted universal acclaim. It showed lavani artistes giving a performance. However, they are soon stopped by an angry crowd, who demand Eetha (Shraddha) to come on stage. Meanwhile, visuals show Eetha backstage getting ready for her performance while being nine months pregnant. She soon goes into labour and is seen in agony as she goes through painful labour cramps. A voiceover asks Eetha to skip the performance as she may die, but she insists because she wants to set a precedent, and is seen returning to the stage right after giving birth to her child.

As per the latest buzz, The following visuals show Eetha’s influence in the industry and her power over the audience. She is seen walking among a crowd that cheers her on. The teaser ends with the voiceover calling her a “toofan”. The teaser of Eetha was screened alongside Cocktail 2 in theatres.

In further updates, The movie follows Vithabai Narayangaonkar, a renowned Marathi Tamasha and Lavani performer who rose from humble beginnings to become one of Maharashtra’s most celebrated folk theatre artists. The movie also stars Randeep Hooda, Anant Joshi, and others. It is co-produced by Dinesh Vijan’s Maddock Films.

On top of that, Eetha is based on the life of the legendary Lavani artist Vithabai Narayangaonkar, a towering figure in Maharashtra's Lavani and Tamasha traditions. She became one of the most respected folk artists of her time and inspired generations of performers.

Her contribution to Indian folk arts was recognised by the President of India in 1957 and again in 1990. But behind the applause and fame was a life filled with hardship. Despite being celebrated across the state, Vithabai is believed to have spent her final years battling financial difficulties. Her passion for the art form lived on through her family, with her daughters and sons-in-law also taking up Lavani and Tamasha.

title: Hrithik Roshan agrees with filmmaker about audience addiction to stardom over cinema: ‘We haven't grown up’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Journalist-turned-filmmaker Pratim D Gupta of late penned a long post on Instagram about how Vijay Sethupathi and Sai Pallavi shooting in Kolkata got more attention than Mani Ratnam returning to the city or shooting with cinematographer Avik Mukhopadhyay. Star Hrithik Roshan commented on his post, seemingly agreeing that the audience is addicted to stardom rather than to love for cinema.

Adding to this, Hrithik Roshan shared that in India people still believe a star is whatever is seen on-screen. Filmmaker’s post on cinema and stardom In a long post, Pratim called the way cinema is celebrated in India ‘heartbreaking’. He wrote that Mani returned to Kolkata to shoot a movie after Yuva, but the focus remained on Sethupathi and Pallavi. He also called out how nobody seemed to care that Mani was collaborating with Avik, a three-time National Award winner. The cinematographer was shooting a Tamil movie for the first time.

Meanwhile, “Perhaps this is not just a media problem. Perhaps it is a cultural problem. We have created a strange hierarchy where being seen has become more important than having made something,” wrote Pratim, adding, “A star walks into a restaurant and it becomes news. A great filmmaker walks into a city and we barely notice. A star waves from a car and thousands of people gather. A cinematographer creates an image that stays in our heads for twenty years and most people don't even know his name.”
Notably, He ended the note with, “Cinema is bigger than stardom. And if we don't learn to celebrate the people who make cinema, we will eventually reduce cinema itself to star spotting.”
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Pratim D Gupta (@pratimdgupta)

In further updates, Hrithik commented under Pratim’s post and agreed with him, “Cinema is bigger than stardom (red heart emoji) well shared (clapping emoji). Unfortunately we have a very superficial understanding of cinema here in india.” The star further claimed that the audience here believes that whatever the star does on-screen reflects who they are in real life.

On top of that, “Like how kids believe. Somehow we haven't grown up to understand where the actual art lies. I hope more people discuss this. And start getting fascinated by all the other perhaps even more important aspects of filmmaking,” he added.

Pratim was a journalist before debuting as a filmmaker with the 2012 Dia Mirza-starrer Paanch Adhyay. He has since helmed Bengali films such as X: Past Is Present, Shaheb Bibi Golaam and Maacher Jhol. His most recent movie was Ranna Baati in 2025. He debuted on OTT with the 2023 Netflix web series Tooth Pari: When Love Bites. In 2025, he helmed Karma Korma for Hoichoi.

title: Sunny Leone wraps up her next titled Chudail in Uttar Pradesh: Report
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Directed by TLV Prasad, the movie also stars Mandana Karimi and Rahul Dev and marks producer Mahindra Dhariwal’s 50th production.

Adding to this, The movie is as per reports being positioned along the lines of the horror comedy genre that has found a strong audience in India, with Sunny's character being pitted against another supernatural force played by Mandana Karimi. A source told Mid-day , “Set in North India, Chudail sees Sunny as a spirit haunting the streets of Bulandshahr and luring men. But her character isn’t an all-black witch. As the story progresses, it’s opened up that she faced grave injustice in her lifetime and that sparked her need for vengeance in the afterlife. Extensive VFX has been used in the movie to showcase Sunny’s transformation from a beautiful woman to a spirit with glowing eyes and reversed feet.”

Meanwhile, Interestingly, Chudail also marks a return to the horror genre in Bollywood for Sunny Leone after her appearance in Ragini MMS 2 , in which she played a woman who becomes possessed by a supernatural entity. The soon-to-release movie, however, is expected to combine horror elements with comedy and music.

Notably, Producer Mahindra Dhariwal verified details about the scale and language plans for the project, telling the portal, “It’s designed as a pan-India movie, shot in Hindi and dubbed in other languages [Malayalam, Tamil, and Telugu]. We shot the movie in a haveli in Bulandshahr in Uttar Pradesh. Sunny’s Ragini MMS 2 (2014), where she played a possessed woman, was a big hit, and now she is returning as a chudail (witch) in the horror comedy. It’s also a musical. We are planning a theatrical rollout in September-end.”

As per the latest buzz, The producer also opened up that Chudail holds particular significance for him as it will mark his 50th movie as a producer. With the makers planning a pan-India rollout, the project is being prepared for audiences beyond the Hindi-speaking market, with dubbed versions planned in Malayalam, Tamil and Telugu.

In further updates, Directed by TLV Prasad, the horror comedy also stars Rahul Dev. The star will as per reports play a priest who becomes involved in the conflict between the two supernatural forces, adding another layer to the central battle.

title: Anupam Kher on his legacy: ‘Want to be remembered as a great person, not an actor’| Interview
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

More than four decades after making his debut in Bollywood , Anupam Kher continues to reinvent himself with an array of diverse roles. But the star believes his journey is far from over, insisting that he still has a long way to go.

Adding to this, Anupam Kher has built a career on versatility, balancing drama and thrill with comedy. While his body of work has collected him immense acclaim, Anupam says he hopes his legacy extends beyond his performances. More than being remembered as an accomplished star, he wants people to remember him as a good human being.

Meanwhile, Anupam has built a career on versatility, balancing drama and thrill with comedy. He won hearts as the lovable father in Hum Aapke Hain Koun..!, delivered memorable laughs in Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge and Khosla Ka Ghosla . He has proved that his journey has always been about much more than comic roles. Beyond his comic turns, Anupam has delivered several hard-hitting performances in films such as A Wednesday , The Kashmir Files, and most of late, Metro... In Dino.

Notably, “Abhi toh shuruwat hui hai, abhi toh bahut kuch karna hai (I have just begun. I have still so much to do)... I enjoy my journey on a daily basis. I don't look back. I'm very proud of the fact that I have achieved so much, but I don't gloat about it,” Anupam tells us.

As per the latest buzz, The 71-year-old continues, “I don't carry the burden of Anupam Kher on my shoulders. Every day is a great day. Every day life is beautiful. Every day I wake up, and I say ‘Thank you, God, I woke up’. A lot of people do not wake up.”
In further updates, When asked how he would like his legacy to be remembered, Anupam says he hopes people look beyond his films and remember him for the person he was.

On top of that, He shared, “I want people to remember that he was a good human being. That's it. That's what matters because merese phele bahut kamal ke log aaye hain, aur mere baad bhi ayenge (There have been many remarkable people before me, and there will be many more after me)… Abhi Ashaji aur Dharam ji gaye hain, jinhone kitna kaam kiya tha (Just of late, we lost Asha ji (Asha Bhosle) and Dharam ji (Dharmendra), who had contributed so much through their work)."

“I'm not interested in being remembered as a great star. Of course, there have been so many great actors. But if I have touched people's lives somewhere, that is what stays with people for a longer time,” he shares.

title: Kangana Ranaut calls Naseeruddin Shah a ‘lomdi’ for his comment on student protests: ‘Khaate toh iss desh ka hain’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star and BJP MP Kangana Ranaut has taken a sharp jibe at veteran star Naseeruddin Shah over his recent comments on the student protests. The star had earlier spoken on why A-list celebrities had not come out publicly about the demonstrations that were happening in the country last month. He had shared, “They'll do it when their conscience tells them to. There's a saying: a dog with a bone in its mouth can't bark." Kangana has now wondered why the veteran star is silent on the protests happening in Jharkhand.

Adding to this, Kangana Ranaut has reacted to Naseeruddin Shah's comments about student protests. What Kangana shared Taking to her Instagram Stories, Kangana reposted a comment made by star Piyush Mishra on Naseeruddin's comments, where he cross-questioned his silence on the student protests happening in Jharkhand. She wrote a separate note in the caption which read, “Sach toh ye hai ki har koi kisi na kisi ka kutta hai lekin mujhe iss baat ka garv hai ki main jiss ghar (desh) ki roti khati hoon uski rakhwaali karti hoon, uske liye ladti hoon. Naseer saab khate toh iss desh ke hain lekin ladte padosi desh ke liye hai (The truth is that each and everyone of us is someone's pet. I am proud that I protect and defend the same house from where I get my food. But Naseer saab eats from this land and defends the neighbours).”
Meanwhile, She added, “PS In today's time it is a compliment to be called a dog because loyalty and cuteness is so rare. I rather be a dog than a lomdi (wolf) like Naseeruddin.”

Notably, Meanwhile, several MPs of the BJP on Tuesday accused Congress leader Rahul Gandhi of being either "culpable" or "incapable" of taking action against the Jharkhand government over the alleged police action against protesting job aspirants. Kangana demanded answers over the alleged police action against students.

As per the latest buzz, "First of all, look at what is happening in Jharkhand. The children are being subjected to atrocities. They have been beaten very brutally. Water cannons and tear gas are being used against them. We are demanding answers on this," Ranaut shared.

In further updates, Several agitators and four policemen were injured during a clash near the Jharkhand Assembly on Monday, as police used water cannons, tear gas and lathi-charged job aspirants protesting against alleged irregularities in recruitment examinations, officials shared.

title: Supreme Court Refuses To Entertain Third Petition Filed By Same Petitioner For Regulation Of Religious...
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Listen to this Article The Supreme Court today(August 10) dismissed as withdrawn a petition seeking registration, recognition and supervision of all institutions imparting religious education to children up to 14 years.

Adding to this, A bench comprising Justice Aravind Kumar and Justice Vipul M Pancholi, at the outset, clarified that they wouldn't entertain the third petition filed on the same issue when the Court had earlier refused to entertain two similar petitions filed by the same petitioner, Ashwini Upadhyay, on the same cause.

Meanwhile, The bench noted that a similar petition [W.P.(C) No. 590/2026] was earlier considered by a bench comprising Justice Dipankar Datta and Justice Satish Chandra Sharma. That bench had noted that a previous writ petition on the same cause [WP 143/2026] was disposed of directing him to make a representation. Subsequently, WP 590 was dismissed, stating that the petitioner must await the decision on the representation given to the.

Notably, Today, the petitioner filed the third writ petition claiming that no decision has been taken on his representation. Justice Kumar responded: " You might be espousing a very good cause...It will not take us a minute to say that the third petition is to be dismissed immediately because your remedy is simple: go file a contempt; we will entertain it....This matter may require consideration after the representation but not before it."

As per the latest buzz, He added: "Mr Upadhyay, you have already taken a writ which is in your favour, enforce the writ. Only in the capacity of members of the Supreme Court Legal Services Committee, we are giving you free advise...You should not hit a self-goal...Don't spoil a good case, you have got an order, enforce it."
In further updates, Ultimately, Upadhyay decided to withdraw the petition.

On top of that, As per Upadhyay's petition, thousands of non-registered institutions are radicalising gullible young children under the garb of imparting religious instructions, as they are not supervised by the State. He has shared that this has serious implications not only for internal security but also for fraternity, unity and national integration, as one can easily brainwash young children in the name of religion.

He has also sought a direction that semi-religious minority and non-minority educational institutions can't fall under Article 30, as it is a specific reiteration of Article 19(1)(g) and doesn't confer any additional rights. And, 'educational institutions of their choice' in Article 30(a) means 'secular/professional educational institutions of their choice' and not religious educational institutions. Institutions which impart religious instructions to promote any 'religion' are covered under Article 26(a).

title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE specs leak in full: here's what will change and what will stay the same - GSMArena.com news
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

There have been several major leaks surrounding the soon-to-release Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, but now we have the full picture thanks to WinFuture . Don’t worry, it’s not just you – we find it pretty hard to spot the differences between this and the S25 FE picture too.

Adding to this, Instead of reusing the Exynos 2400 for a third time, the new FE model will feature the Exynos 2500 . The chip is fabbed on Samsung’s 3nm Gate-All-Around (GAA) node and features a 10-core CPU (1+7+2) and an Xclipse 950 GPU (based on AMD RDNA 3 with 8 work groups).

Meanwhile, The chipset will be paired with 8GB of RAM and 128GB or 256GB storage – right now is not the time to increase memory capacities. Even so, the Galaxy S26 FE will not be spared from a price hike – the 128GB model is expected to cost €800. That is €50 more than the S25 FE in the same configuration, which cost €750 at launch.

Notably, The new model will have the same overall dimensions – it will be 7.4mm thick and weigh 193g (that’s 3g more than its predecessor, but it won’t be noticeable). The phone will be rated IP68 for dust and water resistance.

As per the latest buzz, This is with the same 4,900mAh battery capacity. Naturally, the battery will support the same 45W fast wired and 15W wireless charging. Note that there is some talk of this being a Si/C battery - whether it is or it isn’t, the EPREL rating for charge cycles will go down from 2,000 on the S25 FE to 1,200. We saw the same with the Galaxy Z8 series. Anyway, the new chipset may help extend battery life – the official rating has the phone lasting 50 hours on a single charge, up from 42:37h for the previous model.

In further updates, The front will feature the Samsung special – a 6.7” Dynamic AMOLED 2X display with 1,080 x 2,340px resolution and 120Hz refresh rate. The display will have a typical brightness of 1,200 nits, going up to 1,900 nits in high brightness mode. The front-facing camera will have a 12MP sensor and an f/2.2 fixed focus lens.

On top of that, The 50MP main (f/1.8) and 8MP telephoto with a 3x f/2.4 lens will use the same sensors as before . However, the ultra-wide will get a new 12MP sensor (replacing the old 12MP sensor). The main camera has a 8K at 30fps video mode, along with 4K at 60fps.

We don’t know the launch date for the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE – that may be the only thing that we don’t know about the phone. That shared, the S25 FE was revealed in September, so “next month” is a solid guess.

title: Shiprocket crosses Rs 2,000 Cr revenue in FY26; loss rises 7% to Rs 79 Cr
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

New Update Logistics and e-commerce enablement platform Shiprocket crossed the Rs 2,000 crore rupees revenue mark in FY26, with operating revenue rising 24% year-on-year, while its losses widened 7% to Rs 79 crore rupees ahead of its public listing.

Adding to this, Zomato-backed Shiprocket reported a 24% year-on-year increase in operating revenue to Rs 2,024 crore rupees in FY26 from Rs 1,632 crore rupees in the previous fiscal, according to its financial statements disclosed in the RHP.

Meanwhile, While Shiprocket's core business, comprising its domestic shipping platform and value-added technology offerings, grew 13.7% year-on-year to Rs 1,485 crore rupees, contributing 73.4% of total operating revenue, its emerging businesses, including the cross-border platform, marketing, and omnichannel offerings, generated the remaining Rs 539 crore rupees, up 65% year-on-year.

Notably, Server and communication costs stood at Rs 58 crore rupees, while advertising and promotional expenses jumped 71% year-on-year to Rs 36 crore rupees. Higher spending across warehouse management, depreciation and amortisation, finance costs, and other overheads pushed the company's total expenditure up 23% to Rs 2,153 crore rupees in FY26 from Rs 1,749 crore rupees in the previous fiscal.

As per the latest buzz, With revenue and expenses growing at a similar pace, Shiprocket's net loss increased marginally by 7% to Rs 79 crore rupees in FY26 from Rs 74 crore rupees a year earlier. The loss included Rs 112 crore rupees in ESOP expenses.

In further updates, The company spent Rs 1.06 to earn every rupee of operating revenue compared with Rs 1.07 in the previous fiscal. Its EBITDA margin and ROCE -3.31% ROCE stood at -6.39% in FY26. As of March 2026, It reported current assets of Rs 1,017 crore rupees, including cash and bank balances of Rs 188 crore rupees. Shiprocket has trimmed its IPO size by 31% to Rs 1,617.48 crore rupees from Rs 2,342.35 crore rupees proposed in the UDRHP. The reduction includes a cut in the fresh issue to Rs 885.5 crore rupees from Rs 1,100 crore rupees and the OFS to Rs 731.98 crore rupees from Rs 1,242.35 crore rupees.

title: A story that dives into the Mily Mist IPO.
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Finshots Daily Finshots Markets Finshots Money Infographics Ditto Insurance 11 August 2026 • Capital Markets A look at the Milky Mist IPO In today’s Finshots, we break down the Milky Mist IPO , which opens for subscription today and closes on August 13th.
Adding to this, When you think of Milky Mist, what comes to mind?
Meanwhile, Probably paneer, curd, Greek yogurt and all kinds of other dairy products. Everything except fresh packets of milk that you’d typically get from giants like Amul or Nandini.
Notably, But a dairy company that doesn’t sell the very milk that goes into making these products sounds a little strange, right?

As per the latest buzz, In 1985, before Milky Mist officially kicked off, the company’s founder, Chairman and Managing Director T Sathish Kumar’s family was already in the milk trading business. Kumar, who came from an agricultural background, joined the business but soon realised that milk supply was highly unorganised.
In further updates, So he decided to try something different: making paneer, which was seeing growing demand at the time.

On top of that, More than three decades later, Milky Mist has stuck to that basic philosophy, just with a dash of diversification. It sells value-added dairy products such as cheese, paneer, butter, curd, ghee, yogurt and ice cream, along with frozen, ready-to-eat and ready-to-cook products.

And there’s a good reason for this. Fresh milk is a low-margin commodity, with margins typically around 5-8%. Value-added products, on the other hand, can offer margins upwards of 8% and even reach 40% for products like ice cream.

title: Ram Gopal Varma’s Police Company to explore Dawood Ibrahim’s underworld era; Harshvardhan Rane set to lead
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Filmmaker Ram Gopal Varma is making a return to the realm of the underbelly of Mumbai. He is all set to make his next movie titled Police Company, with T-Series bankrolling the project. The movie has been inspired by the fight against organised crime by the Mumbai police force. It will be headlined by Harshvardhan Rane .

Adding to this, Ram Gopal Varma to explore Dawood Ibrahim, Chhota Rajan’s underworld in Police Company; Harshvardhan Rane set to lead the movie as Daya Nayak. The announcement Ram shared the name of the movie and its concept via social media to give people some insights about his movie’s plot. Explaining the distinction between a criminal gang and a strong police force, Ram shared, “My NEXT movie's NAME being produced by T SERIES is .. POLICE COMPANY. With the tagline 'It Is More Dangerous Than D Company'. The police is an institution, and an underworld company is a money-making organisation.. But when an institution is given extra powers, it will soon become a company.”

Meanwhile, This movie returns to a period in Mumbai’s underground world when there was great violence. Ram remembered that after Dawood Ibrahim got rid of all those rival gangs, he managed to make his own gang, which later got the name D Company. He wrote, "After DAWOOD IBRAHIM brutally finished most of his rival gangs, he grew his GANG into a COMPANY and then left for DUBAI, leaving his protegee CHOTA RAJAN to head the operations of D COMPANY."

Notably, Dawood and Chhota Rajan’s equation came crashing down due to which there was a huge change in the criminal underworld of the city. Explaining how the situation unfolded, Varma wrote, "Subsequently, a chain of events led to a split between Dawood and Rajan, which in turn caused a vacuum in the Mumbai underworld. Taking advantage of the situation, many other gangs jumped in to stake their claim for the top spot, creating a massive outburst of criminal activities," he added.

As per the latest buzz, With the underworld becoming increasingly violent, the Mumbai police responded by forming a special squad to take on the gangs. According to Ram, the squad carried out a large-scale crackdown over several years. He wrote, "In a panicky situation, a special squad was created which, between 1997 and 2004, killed more than 300 gangsters," he wrote on X, formerly Twitter.

In further updates, Police Company will focus on this special police squad and, in particular, Daya Nayak, one of its best-known members. Harshvardhan Rane has been chosen to portray the former police officer, marking his collaboration with Varma for the crime drama. Confirming the casting, the filmmaker wrote, “POLICE COMPANY is the story inspired by that SQUAD based on one of its team members DAYA NAYAK which is being played by HARSH VARDHAN RANE.”

On top of that, Ram has also indicated that the movie will feature a large ensemble cast, although the rest of the names are yet to be revealed. He has promised a “huge ensemble cast,” suggesting that the story will feature several characters from the turbulent period.
Following the announcement, in next set of his tweets, he shared the first look of his lead star. “3 more pics of HARSHVARDHAN RANE as DAYA NAYAK in POLICE COMPANY.”

body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Copied Husharu Pittalu is being well supported by none other than producer D Suresh Babu of Suresh Productions. Bikshu is the director, while Venkat Yadav produced the movie under his Rudra Kranti Pictures banner. It is a complete youthful movie set in Telangana . Anshu and Vasavi Ganesan are playing the lead roles. The movie has completed its formalities and is being rolled out by leading production house Asian Suresh Films. It is slated for a theatrical rollout on August 15.

Adding to this, The makers rolled out the teaser and songs of the movie earlier, and they went widely shared on social media. Now, producer D Suresh Babu unveiled the trailer of the movie on Monday. "Bekkem Venugopal introduced the director Bikshu and producer Naveen Yadav to me, and they asked me to watch Husharu Pittalu a few months ago. The producer and the director hail from Telangana and made this movie with a lot of passion. Even our Suresh Productions team watched the movie and gave good positive feedback," shared Suresh Babu at the trailer launch event.

Meanwhile, The producer shared that after receiving all the positive feedback, he decided to rollout the movie through Suresh Asian Films. "They overcame all the challenges they faced during the making of the movie and reached this stage. They shot some scenes again and even suggested a few corrections, which they incorporated by shooting those portions again. They are also marketing the movie aggressively. I believe this is definitely a movie that will be worth the audience’s time and money," shared Suresh Babu.

Notably, The makers have already started screening the movie in selected cities, where it received a good response. "A few shows are being screened before the rollout, and with the positive feedback and word of mouth, the movie will reach an even wider audience. I asked them to show the movie to as many people as they can because if positive word of mouth spreads, the audience will definitely come to watch this movie in theatres," shared Suresh Babu. He added that he sincerely wished the entire team great success.

As per the latest buzz, Bekkem Venugopal expressed his happiness about supporting a good movie. "Audiences have proved many times that they will support good cinema. I am confident that they will support this movie as well. Once audiences come to theatres and watch the movie, there will not be even a single negative word about it. This is definitely a movie that will satisfy everyone," shared Bekkem.

In further updates, Director Bikshu is also confident about the movie, saying that the teaser went widely shared when it was rolled out sometime back. "I am now more confident that this trailer will be liked even more. I have written the story and screenplay based on what I have observed in society. Every scene has been presented very naturally. Along with commercial elements, the movie also carries a message, and this movie can be watched by the entire family together," shared Bikshu.

Has a Tesla, a pool & Rs 100 crore rupees assets Manish Kumar Gupta would also allegedly pose as IAS officer and tell govt officials he could make corruption cases disappear for a tidy sum, even ran a jobs-for-money racket. Alisha Dutta 10 August, 2026 09:59 pm IST Facebook Twitter WhatsApp Linkedin Accused Manish Kumar Gupta; (inset) his home in Jamalpur Bazar | By special arrangement Follow Us : Text Size: A- A+ --> New Delhi: “There is a corruption case against you, if you pay up, I could make it disappear,” he would call and say to junior government officials in Bihar’s Gogri. Meanwhile, to those looking for jobs, he would say he could get them one in exchange for money. Even people booked in criminal cases would be told he could make the FIRs vanish in exchange for a sum.

Adding to this, That was how Manish Kumar Gupta rolled. Sometimes he shared he was an IAS officer, sometimes a vigilance officer and other times an undercover agent working for none other than National Security Adviser (NSA) Ajit Doval.
Meanwhile, The matter came to light when Gogri police station got a tip-off Saturday afternoon. The caller shared that one Manish Kumar Gupta has been duping people posing as an IAS officer.

Notably, “On 8 August, we received a tip-off that one Manish Kumar Gupta uses a Government of India placard on his two private vehicles and tells people that he is an IAS officer,” read the FIR, accessed by the Print.

As per the latest buzz, A team comprising Khagaria police and a District Investigation Unit (DIU) then raided his residence in Jamalpur Bazar for nearly eight hours. They learnt that Gupta was not just posing as an IAS but also as a “covert agent” under NSA Ajit Doval, shared Khagaria Superintendent of Police (SP) Bhanu Pratap Singh.

In further updates, “During questioning, the individual identified himself as Manish Kumar [alias Manish Kumar Gupta], son of Parmeshwar Gupta. He displayed an ID card on his mobile phone identifying him as ‘Manish Kumar, Central Vigilance Commission’ and claimed to be an undercover agent for NSA Ajit Doval; verification revealed these claims to be prima facie fake. He has been formally arrested, and further legal action is underway,” the SP added.

On top of that, SP Singh further told The Print that initial investigation has opened up that the accused, along with several others operating in Bihar, other Indian states and the UK, were running a racket. “He would blackmail government officers by saying that he was a vigilance officer and if they pay up then the soon-to-release corruption case against them will go away,” he shared, adding that he would tell people looking for government jobs that he “knew senior officers and could get them jobs in exchange for money”. The accused would also act as a mediator and settle cases in exchange for money in local police stations.

Tesla, pool, ‘Govt of India’ placards, assets worth Rs 100 crore rupees During the eight-hour raid, police recovered two luxury cars, including a driverless Tesla displaying the ‘Government of India placards’.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ranveer Singh's exit from Don 3 saw Bollywood divided, legal notices being sent and movie body getting involved. While Farhan Akhtar and Ranveer remain at loggerheads regarding the matter, Farhan, in a recent interaction, seems to have taken a jibe at Ranveer Singh, calling his exit a 'pattern'.

Adding to this, Ranveer Singh and Farhan Akhtar are embroiled in a dispute over the movie Don 3. 'Seems to be a pattern nowadays' During an interaction with The Hollywood Reporter India on the occasion of 25 years of his directorial debut Dil Chahta Hai, Farhan was speaking about the movie's lead star Saif Ali Khan and how he wanted to quit the movie just days before they were supposed to start filming.

Meanwhile, Farhan shared that before the movie's shooting began, Saif faced a date issue as the schedule of another movie he was set to do shifted. Since Saif was in a difficult situation, he decided to leave Farhan's movie despite everyone trying to convince him to stay. The director shared, “For me, it was just like my head was destroyed because it was... When we met him, when we got into it, there was nobody else who could've played that part. It was just impossible. It was a true heartbreak.”

Notably, While speaking about Saif's exit, Farhan recalled Ranveer's exit from his movie Don 3 just days before they were supposed to start shooting. Taking a playful jibe at the star without naming him, he shared, “It was a month away from filming, which seems to be a pattern nowadays.”
As per the latest buzz, The interviewer laughed out loud after hearing the obvious dig at Ranveer. Farhan responded to the laugh and shared, “But, not just with me…things like this happen too.”

In further updates, For the unversed, Ranveer chose to walk away from Don 3 days before filming was set to begin. In several reports, Ranveer's exit was cited as the star blaming Farhan for approaching Hrithik Roshan for the role behind his back as his career struggled. However, when he got a major hit like Dhurandhar last December, Farhan decided to retain Ranveer Singh in the movie.

On top of that, Farhan refuted such claims. Ranveer as per reports offered to return the signing amount, but the makers demanded compensation of ₹ 45 crore rupees for the pre-production losses incurred, as per reports.

Later, Farhan approached the Federation of Western India Cine Employees (FWICE) regarding the matter, and the movie body revealed a non-cooperation move against the star over his decision to leave Don 3, only to later revoke the directive. They even clarified that Ranveer had not been banned. The star also as per reports issued a legal notice to the movie body after they had issued the directive. Ranveer has largely stayed silent on the matter and has communicated through his spokesperson.

title: How and when to see the solar eclipse
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Homepage Accessibility links Skip to content Accessibility Help BBC Account Notifications Home News Sport Weather iPlayer Sounds Bitesize CBeebies CBBC Food Home News Sport Business Innovation Culture Travel Earth Video Live More menu Search BBC Home News Sport Weather iPlayer Sounds Bitesize CBeebies CBBC Food Home News Sport Business Innovation Culture Travel Earth Video Live Close menu english navigation Animations on Animations off Animations on Animations off How and when to see the solar eclipse What you need to know about the UK and Europe's best eclipse in 27 years By Paul Sargeant, Georgina Rannard and the Visual Journalism team 10 August 2026 Science On the evening of 12 August, the whole of the UK will see its most dramatic partial solar eclipse in nearly three decades. The same eclipse will be visible across Europe and some will enjoy the ultimate solar spectacle: a total solar eclipse. Millions are expected to gather in northern Spain and on the west coast of Iceland, hoping clear skies will allow them to experience an awe-inspiring event as the Sun, the Moon and the Earth line up in space.
Adding to this, The light will dim and the crowds will find themselves in a strange, hushed twilight.
Meanwhile, The temperature will suddenly drop and the wind slows, and even changes direction, as the Sun begins to disappear behind the Moon.
Notably, For a brief moment a flare of sunlight on the Moon's rim will make it seem as if a huge diamond ring is hanging in the sky.
As per the latest buzz, Then the flare will vanish and it will seem as if a giant hole has devoured the Sun.

In further updates, While in dusk of the Moon's shadow, everything is uncannily still: birds can go quiet, thinking it is time to roost, while nocturnal insects may wake up and begin to chirp. And then - if the Sun has not yet set - daylight will return as quickly as it left and the world will continue as if nothing had happened. It's a singular feeling that some people travel around the world in the hope of experiencing.

On top of that, Where can I see the eclipse? For most people in the path of the total eclipse, the Sun will be hidden for less than two minutes - much shorter than four minutes experienced in the US in 2024. It will begin at the tip of Siberia in Russia, before curving around between Iceland and Greenland, and a large proportion of the path of the total eclipse will pass through uninhabited stretches of the Arctic Circle and the North Atlantic Ocean.

The last place on land to view the eclipse will be on the islands of Majorca and Menorca, before the shadow disappears in the Mediterranean Sea as the Sun sets. In fact, in large parts of Europe - particularly in Central and Eastern Europe - the Sun will still be partially eclipsed as it sets over the horizon. Though the total eclipse will only be visible along a narrow path, the area covered by a partial eclipse will stretch across almost the whole of Europe. Dublin will see a partial eclipse covering 94% of the Sun, Paris 92%, London 90%, Berlin 85%.

title: CINTAA REJECTS claims of Executive Committee dissolution; says body remains "fully operational and functional"
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

According to CINTAA, its Constitution states that the Executive Committee can be dissolved only if more than 50 per cent of its elected members resign. The Association shared that condition has not been met and, therefore, the EC remains valid and operational.

Adding to this, The Association also clarified that vacancies within the Executive Committee have been filled in accordance with its constitutional provisions. According to CINTAA, eligible members who were next in line based on the voting count have been inducted to fill the vacant positions.

Meanwhile, Adv. Suvigya Vidyarthi, Legal Counsel representing CINTAA, shared, “The version which has been circulating that the EC of CINTAA is dissolved is totally wrong, misconceived and lacks any judicial sanctity. As per the Constitution of CINTAA, the EC shall dissolve only when more than 50 per cent of the elected members of the EC resign, which is not the case at hand.”
Notably, A post shared by CINTAA | Cine & TV Artistes' Association (@cintaaofficial)

As per the latest buzz, CINTAA also raised objections to the reported involvement of the Federation of Western India Cine Employees (FWICE) in the matter. Vidyarthi alleged that FWICE had attempted to exercise powers that CINTAA does not recognise under its constitutional framework.

In further updates, “FWICE has now jumped into the fray and, in CINTAA’s considered view, has sought to assume powers that are neither known to nor recognised under CINTAA’s constitutional framework. Acting, as we understand it, at the behest of certain disgruntled individuals, it has issued directions which CINTAA considers wholly untenable and contrary to the Constitution of the Association,” he shared.
On top of that, He further asserted that external directions cannot override the internal governance of an autonomous trade union.

“The Executive Committee of CINTAA remains very much in existence and continues to function for the welfare of artistes and for the protection and strengthening of the rights of vulnerable actors. CINTAA will take all appropriate steps available to it to safeguard the autonomy of the Association, uphold its Constitution and protect the larger interests of its members,” Vidyarthi added.

title: A.R. Rahman’s son injured in car accident in Chennai, discharged from hospital: Report
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
A.R. Rahman’s son A.R. Ameen suffered minor injuries after his car collided with a cab in Chennai. He was treated and discharged from the hospital.

Adding to this, As per reports, the accident took place at around 3:30 a.m. as Ameen and his friend were travelling towards Guindy along Jawaharlal Nehru Road. The collision as per reports occurred near Olympia Tech Park when a cab entered the main road from a side road.

Meanwhile, The impact resulted in both vehicles being damaged, while Ameen and his friend suffered minor injuries. They were taken to a private hospital, where doctors examined them and provided the necessary treatment. Police have verified that their injuries were not serious and that both were later discharged.

Notably, A passenger who was travelling in the cab was also injured in the collision. The passenger was taken to the Kalaignar Centenary Super Speciality Hospital for treatment and was subsequently discharged.

As per the latest buzz, At present, there have been no reports of life-threatening injuries among those involved in the accident. The circumstances surrounding the collision are, however, being investigated by the Adyar Traffic Investigation Wing (TIW).

In further updates, The police are examining the sequence of events to determine how the cab entered Jawaharlal Nehru Road and whether factors such as speed contributed to the accident. Investigators are also expected to review CCTV footage recorded by cameras installed around the accident spot. Statements from the drivers and occupants of both vehicles will also form part of the investigation.

On top of that, The accident took place during the early morning hours, when traffic on the arterial road was relatively light. Jawaharlal Nehru Road, also known as the Inner Ring Road, is one of Chennai’s major traffic corridors and connects several residential and commercial areas across the city.

A.R. Ameen is the son of Oscar-winning composer A.R. Rahman and has established himself as a singer and performer. He has worked on several musical projects and has also performed alongside his father at concerts and other musical events.

title: ‘Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna did not endorse infidelity’: Karan Johar recalls a couple walked out midway during the show
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Karan Johar ’s 2006 movie Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna received mixed reviews upon rollout, but it went on to become a cult classic. As the movie completes two decades since its rollout, the filmmaker posted on Instagram to comment on the surprising reactions he received from viewers.

Adding to this, Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna received polarising reviews upon rollout, shared Karan Johar. What Karan shared Karan penned a long note across several slides to recall memories from its rollout back in the day. He wrote in the caption, “On the eve of the 20th anniversary of Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna…penning down some unique encounters & realisations I had, thanks to this movie!”

Meanwhile, The first slide showed Karan recalling when he wanted to watch a movie preview in a theatre. At one point, when Shah Rukh Khan and Rani Mukerji 's characters make love in the movie, viewers were left in shock. “I was sitting behind a very traditionally dressed middle aged couple (and for some reason they seemed angry and the anger was taken out on the poor popcorn they were chomping on!)… When sir Kurta realised it wasn't a dream sequence he looked at his wife angrily and insinuated an immediate exit! They left the cinema and my heart sank!”
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Karan Johar (@karanjohar)

As per the latest buzz, Then another woman who had come with her daughter to see the movie confronted Karan for making such a movie. “I took my daughter to see a happy movie with songs and dances and family values because it's YOUR movie. The DAY she got her DIVORCE and this is what I saw!! Shame on you. I was worried she may hit me so I scurried away from her and encountered some more angry faces,” he added.

In further updates, “The movie rolled out to hugely polarising reviews and audience feedback... From being called brave, my best work to anti 'sanskaari' values and immense hate - I heard it all...” he added. Karan admitted that there were flaws in the movie, that it was over bloated and had opulent songs, and he knew that the movie had its ‘heart at the right place.’ "The movie did not endorse infidelity (that was never ever my intention) but it did show that stepping out of the boundary of marriage to seek love or desire can destroy your very foundation and family,” he added.
On top of that, Karan concluded by saying that 20 years later, he still receives many interesting views about the movie from viewers. He thanked the movie's cast and crew for their passion.

Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna was Karan Johar’s third directorial venture after Kuch Kuch Hota Hai (1998) and Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham (2001). It marked KJo’s third movie with Rani and Shah Rukh. His last directorial venture was the 2023 rollout Rocky Aur Rani Ki Prem Kahaani . It starred Ranveer Singh and Alia Bhatt, and fetched two National Awards.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Batwara 1947 vs Awarapan 2 show-sharing TUSSLE begins; distributor of Sunny Deol-starrer asks for ALL shows in single-screens; Spider-Man’s rock-steady run complicates the battle
body: Here's the latest update from the Hollywood/Marvel world:

A trade source told Bollywood Hungama , “PVR Inox Pictures, the distributors of Batwara 1947 , have demanded all the shows in single-screen cinemas. This has put single-screen exhibitors in a difficult position because if they agree to the demand, they won’t be able to screen Awarapan 2 at all. And just like Batwara 1947 , Awarapan 2 is also expected to appeal strongly to the mass audience. Meanwhile, the distributors of Awarapan 2 are open to sharing shows in single-screen theatres.”

Adding to this, The source continued, “PVR Inox Pictures has also asked for seven shows a day in two-screen theatres, 10 shows in three-screen multiplexes, 12 shows a day in four-screen cinemas and 15 shows a day in five-screen multiplexes. This demand, too, has caused some discomfort among exhibitors.”

Meanwhile, Explaining the concern further, the source shared, “ Awarapan 2 has a runtime of 2 hours and 20 minutes, while Batwara 1947 is 2 hours and 25 minutes long. As a result, most cinemas can accommodate around five shows per screen in a day. Therefore, a two-screen cinema can play approximately 10 shows daily. If Batwara 1947 is allotted seven of those shows, Awarapan 2 will be left with only three.”

Notably, Meanwhile, an exhibitor pointed out that the two new releases are not the only films that cinemas need to accommodate. “Let’s not forget that Spider-Man: Brand New Day is rock-steady at the ticket-window. It collected Rs. 35 crores on its second Sunday and is expected to continue performing even after the rollout of Batwara 1947 and Awarapan 2 . Many properties would want to retain shows for Spider-Man as well. With the kind of show-sharing demands being made by the team of Batwara 1947, balancing all three films becomes extremely difficult.”

As per the latest buzz, With negotiations still underway, exhibitors are hoping that the distributors arrive at a mutually acceptable show-sharing arrangement soon so that advance bookings for both Batwara 1947 and Awarapan 2 can finally open.
In further updates, Batwara 1947 and Awarapan 2 makers say no to inflated ticket rates

On top of that, Meanwhile, moviegoers would be relieved to know that tickets for Batwara 1947 and Awarapan 2 are unlikely to burn a hole in their pockets. An exhibitor shared, “The distributors of both films have asked us to sell tickets at popular ticket rates rather than smash hit rates. The distributors of Awarapan 2 have also specified that non-national chain cinemas located near national chain properties should match the pricing of the latter.”

An industry insider commented, “The aam junta has already spent a bomb watching The Odyssey and Spider-Man: Brand New Day . Hence, the decision by the makers and distributors of Batwara 1947 and Awarapan 2 to keep ticket prices reasonable will come as a welcome respite.”

title: Exclusive! Poonam Dhillon hits back at CINTAA members allegations after mass resignations
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

In a significant development within the Cine and TV Artistes Association (CINTAA), eight elected members of its Executive Committee have resigned from their respective offices and the association’s Executive Committee with immediate effect, citing a loss of confidence in the present manner of functioning and calling for fresh elections. They alleged that the functioning of the association had increasingly become concentrated around CINTAA President Poonam Dhillon and Senior Vice President Padmini Kolhapure, along with a section of other Executive Committee members.

Adding to this, Poonam Dhillon In conversation with us, Poonam says, “Padmini and I are working hard to bring goodwill to CINTAA by using our resources and contacts; it is not for personal gain. No one else was taking initiatives to do anything for members of the organisation, so I’m shocked by their allegations. These members were trying to protect CAWT (Cine Artistes’ Welfare Trust), a trust formed by senior actors like late Dilip Kumar, Amrish Puri and Amjad Khan and others. This trust has not fulfilled its duty to provide medical facilities for members. In the past few decades, no one on the current committee has raised money for CAWT. We of late raised funds through an event and gifted sarees to artistes like Kavita Krishnamurthy and Madhushree and a kurta to Nitin Mukesh, who performed without charging us. The members who resigned are accusing us of buying sarees, did we buy those sarees for ourselves? We acknowledge that these artistes performed for us at no cost, through these gifts. Padmini and I had called them personally and they performed at our behest.” She adds that the singers did a favour for CINTAA. “We raised 1 crore rupees through these performances, so how is it a problem if we spend 1 lakh on gifts for them?” Poonam questions.

Meanwhile, She goes on to add that these members had been promised certain things and high posts if a new committee comes in. “Puneet (Issar) has barely attended two meetings in two years, but the day they wanted to dissolve the committee, they were beckoned just to vote us out,” reveals the star. She adds that certain members were pressurised to resign. “We still have the majority and the committee still stands," says Poonam. Addressing allegations by General Secretary Upasana Singh, who has called the EGM (Extraordinary General Meeting) by Poonam and her team illegal, the star says, “The resignation of former members was received by the General Secretary and not accepted by EC (Executive Committee). Meanwhile we held an EGM with a member who had withdrawn her resignation and inducted in seven new members on top of the elected list. Only after that resignations were accepted. So the EC stands. This process was vetted by our legal team.” She adds that Padmini and she have been bearing expenses from their own pockets to run CINTAA and have been conducting regular checks on TV sets, educating members on labour codes. The star says she has several other initiatives planned for the betterment of the organisation.

title: Delhi High Court grants Tabu protection from AI misuse, orders removal of 150+ URLs
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Court orders removal across platforms Justice Jyoti Singh, who heard the star’s petition, directed Google, Meta, X and Reddit to take down or disable a large number of URLs allegedly carrying unauthorised and objectionable content about Tabu.

Adding to this, In all, the order covers more than 150 identified URLs. Google has been told to remove 21, eight and five URLs across three separate sets within 36 hours, while Meta must take down 73, 28 and five URLs across three documents in the same window.

Meanwhile, AI-generated content and fake accounts named in plea Tabu’s suit shared that her identity was being commercially exploited through fake event-booking accounts, unauthorised merchandise, fabricated statements and AI-generated or manipulated obscene content. Her plea alleged that scenes from her films were edited, slowed down or zoomed in on intimate portions and circulated online to draw viewers and generate revenue.

Notably, An Instagram account with around 2,000 followers had allegedly used her name, images and video clips to offer bookings for her appearances, an association Tabu shared she never authorised. Websites were also accused of selling mugs, posters, calendars, hoodies and sweatshirts bearing her photographs.

As per the latest buzz, The star further flagged a publication carrying a fabricated and disparaging statement attributed to her, which she shared she never made despite her team issuing clarifications to leading newspapers. The Court termed this an “egregious act” and ordered the concerned publisher to delete the statement from all its platforms within three days.

In further updates, Court cites prior personality rights cases The Court held that Tabu had made out a prima facie case for an ex-parte ad-interim injunction, with the balance of convenience in her favour and a likelihood of irreparable harm without interim protection. It noted that her name and stage name ‘Tabu’, along with her image, voice and likeness, have acquired unique distinctiveness instantly associated with her by the public.

On top of that, Justice Singh referred to earlier Delhi High Court rulings on personality rights, including D.M. Entertainment v. Baby Gift House, Anil Kapoor v. Simply Life India and Jaikishan Kakubhai Saraf v. Peppy Store, observing that misuse of personality rights is not confined to commercial loss but can also affect privacy, personality and the right to live with dignity.

The restraint covers Defendants 1 to 7, including unidentified John Does, and applies to her stage name, real name Tabassum Jamal Hashmi, voice recordings, signatures, images and movie stills, extending to misuse through AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, deepfakes, face morphing and GIFs across websites, apps, social media and the Metaverse.
