Shahid Kapoor, Kriti Sanon and Rashmika Mandanna navigate a messy love triangle in Cocktail 2 , and Alan Ritchson’s Jack Reacher trades small-town justice for the streets of Philadelphia in Reacher season 4 By Prabal Sharma 10 August 2026 It’s time for your weekly update of the latest OTT releases and the next seven days have the perfect blend of movies and TV shows to satiate all your bingeing needs. Shahid Kapoor, Kriti Sanon and Rashmika Mandanna navigate chaos when a loyalty test spirals spectacularly out of control in Cocktail 2 ; Alan Ritchson’s Jack Reacher moves to Philadelphia after a chance subway encounter pulls him into a conspiracy in Reacher Season 4 ; Sunny Sandler prepares for her high school musical debut until her mother’s cancer diagnosis threatens to steal the spotlight in the coming-of-age dramedy Don’t Say Good Luck ; Namashi Chakraborty plays a volatile scholar whose public accusation against his mentor (played by Sanjay Dutt) sets off a nationally televised intellectual firestorm in Aakhri Sawaal ; Miles Franklin’s 1901 Australian novel receives its first television adaptation as Philippa Northeast plays a fiercely independent young woman who must choose between love and her dream of becoming a writer in My Brilliant Career .

Adding to this, Filmed over two years and rolled out as José Mourinho returns to Real Madrid for a second spell, this three-part documentary from Beckham producer John Battsek and BAFTA-nominated director Joe Pearlman traces the manager’s journey from the night he shocked the football world by leading FC Porto to Champions League glory in 2004, through his tenures at Chelsea, Inter Milan, Real Madrid, Manchester United, Tottenham, Roma and Fenerbahçe. Featuring interviews with Sir Alex Ferguson, John Terry, Iker Casillas, Didier Drogba, Zlatan Ibrahimović, Marcelo, Samuel Eto’o, Javier Zanetti, Frank Lampard and Petr Čech.

Meanwhile, The feature-length conclusion to Netflix’s longest-running Brazilian original series Sintonia , which ran for five seasons between 2019 and 2025. Five years after rising to power in São Paulo’s criminal underworld, Nando (Christian Malheiros) is living in Serbia, far from everything he built, when his teenage daughter Bruninha (Duda Pimenta) disappears without a trace. He returns to Brazil, attempting to keep his two worlds separate and rebuild family ties, but danger closes in on the people he loves most.

Notably, Adapted from Lee Child’s 13th Jack Reacher novel, Gone Tomorrow , this season moves the action from the books’ New York setting to Philadelphia. A chance encounter with a distraught woman on the subway goes terribly wrong, drawing Jack Reacher (Alan Ritchson) into a complex conspiracy that reaches the highest echelons of power. Maria Sten returns as Neagley, with Sydelle Noel, Agnez Mo, Anggun, Kevin Corrigan, Marc Blucas, Kathleen Robertson and Christopher Marquette all joining the cast.

As per the latest buzz, Bárbara Mori returns as María, now promoted to lieutenant, in the second season of this acclaimed Spanish-language crime drama inspired by true events. When the body of a student activist is discovered, the Azules are pulled into an investigation that reaches back to the 1968 student massacre in Mexico, one of the darkest and most politically sensitive chapters in the country’s history. Before they can make sense of what they’ve uncovered, a killer begins delivering justice directly to the police department’s door. Natalia Téllez, Amorita Rasgado and Ximena Sariñana also return.

In further updates, Miles Franklin’s landmark 1901 Australian novel—previously adapted into the 1979 movie starring Judy Davis and Sam Neill—receives its first television adaptation, shot entirely in South Australia. Philippa Northeast plays Sybylla Melvyn, a fiercely independent young woman in rural 1900s Australia, who dreams of becoming a writer even as her family pushes her toward marriage. When she meets wealthy neighbour Harry Beecham (Christopher Chung), her plans become complicated.

On top of that, Joanne (Jodi Sta. Maria), a successful TV writer who has spent years carefully rebuilding her life, has her world upended when her estranged mother, Paz (Agot Isidro), suddenly returns home, carrying a deeply buried secret. The unexpected reunion forces the two women to confront their painful past and the complicated, fractured dynamics of their family.

Shane Gillis, Steve Gerben and John McKeever’s workplace comedy about the Valley Forge Automotive Center returns for a third season. Will (Gerben) and Shane (Gillis) are now part-owners of the struggling business, adding new responsibilities to a crew that is still spectacularly ill-equipped to handle them. Chris O’Connor, Kilah Fox, Stavros Halkias and Thomas Haden Church return, with Rachel Blanchard, Matt Walsh, Garret Dillahunt, Bobby Lee and Dan Soder joining as new recurring guests.

title: Rajkummar Rao’s Prahaar eyes September 4 release, set to clash with Mirzapur: The Movie: Report
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Rajkummar Rao’s Prahaar as per reports eyes a September 4 rollout, setting up a clash with Pankaj Tripathi’s Mirzapur: The Movie in theatres.

Adding to this, Now, according to a new report by Mid-Day, Prahaar is looking at a September 4 rollout. However, the proposed date comes with its own challenge as Mirzapur: The Movie has already locked the same date for its theatrical debut. The movie marks the transition of the popular Prime Video crime drama from streaming to the big screen, with Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Divyenndu among the returning cast. The rollout date was officially revealed in February.

Meanwhile, An insider cited by Mid-Day highlighted the dilemma surrounding the potential clash, saying, “That makes the decision tricky for the makers of Prahaar . Mirzapur has three seasons of streaming history behind it and an established fan base. The question within trade circles is how much of that digital fandom will convert into a paid theatrical audience.”

Notably, The September 4 date could therefore put two very different films in competition. While Mirzapur: The Movie comes with the familiarity of an established streaming franchise, Prahaar is a biographical drama centred on special public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam. The movie focuses on Nikam's high-profile case against terrorist Ajmal Kasab following the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks.

As per the latest buzz, The makers of Prahaar are yet to officially announce a new rollout date. According to the report, the team is expected to make an announcement soon after assessing the response to the Mirzapur: The Movie trailer.
In further updates, A source added, “They are looking at a September window. They will announce in a week or so after they gauge the response to Mirzapur The Movie trailer.”

On top of that, Directed by Avinash Arun, Prahaar stars Rajkummar Rao in the lead role, with Wamiqa Gabbi, Jaideep Ahlawat and Sikandar Kher also part of the cast. The movie was earlier scheduled to arrive in cinemas on August 7.

Meanwhile, Mirzapur: The Movie is scheduled to hit theatres worldwide on September 4, 2026. Directed by Gurmmeet Singh and written by Puneet Krishna, the movie is being presented by Amazon MGM Studios and Excel Entertainment.

title: At 83, Amitabh Bachchan admits his food and sleep are taking backseat due to ‘intense’ 24-hours work shifts
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Amitabh Bachchan is often considered one of the best actors in Indian cinema. The star is known for his prolific work, having acted in numerous languages and won multiple awards for his body of work. The veteran star, 83, frequently uses his Tumblr account to engage with followers and share his candid thoughts and opinions. In his latest post, Amitabh shared that he has been working around the clock in 24-hour shifts, often at the expense of time, sleep, and food.

Adding to this, Amitabh Bachchan is currently hosting Kaun Banega Crorepati. What Amitabh shared The star wrote in a post, “Apologies for this weird numbering and the missed Blogs .. The work hours and the intensity of work just did not give me time to get to connect .. so am extremely sorry !!! Work hours were stretching from 7am in the morning to almost 7 am the next day .. days of 24 hrs work .. commitments are commitments and must have preference over any other .. time sleep food et al ..”

Meanwhile, He added, “But a break today as KBC 18th season with Sony does a start .. and on can only pray .. and pray .. I shall be with you in the regularity as before .. but let me organise , or rather let me re organise my system and we shall be in correct connect ..my love and my admiration.”

Notably, This is not the first time that the veteran star has spoken about the importance of work in his life, even after so many decades in the industry. In a post shared earlier this year, Amitabh shared that whenever he does not work for a day, his daily routine gets disrupted, which makes him anxious.

As per the latest buzz, He shared, “A day that spelt ‘lazy’ … no reason whatsoever ... just it seems disturbing to not be working each day ... and when you do not work each day according to a schedule … the entire process of habit forming that pre seeded ... the day suddenly becomes a mystery of deeds, which normally would have worked in perfect unison.”

In further updates, The veteran star is returning to host Kaun Banega Crorepati (KBC) Season 18, which will premiere on Monday, August 10, at 9 pm on Sony Entertainment Television and Sony LIV, with weekday episodes airing Monday to Friday. The new season is built around the theme ‘Sochna Padega’.

On top of that, On the work front, Amitabh was last seen in Kalki 2898 AD . Directed by Nag Ashwin, the movie also starred Prabhas, Deepika Padukone, and Kamal Haasan in lead roles. Big B's portrayal of Ashwatthama in the sci-fi drama won hearts, and the movie became a massive success, grossing over ₹ 1,000 crore rupees worldwide. He is currently shooting for the sequel.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Ram Gopal Varma to direct Harshvardhan Rane in Police Company, based on Daya Nayak’s life
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The movie is based on the life of former Mumbai encounter specialist Daya Nayak and will chronicle his extraordinary journey from fleeing a small village in Mangalore to climbing the ranks of the Mumbai Police. It will trace his eventful life and career as he carried out dozens of underworld elimination operations during his three-decade-long career. This is believed to be a passion project for Varma, who has been attempting to make a biopic on Daya Nayak for years. With T-Series backing the project and Harshvardhan attached to play the lead, the movie has of late regained momentum and is officially back on track. Pre-production is already underway, with shooting scheduled to begin in the third week of August.

Adding to this, “Police Company” is being positioned as the revival of Varma’s popular “Company” franchise, following “Company” (2002) and “D Company” (2021). However, the new movie is entirely standalone and shares no narrative connection with the previous films. Sources indicate that Varma fast-tracked this project after his other crime thriller, “Syndicate”, failed to materialise due to budgetary constraints.

Meanwhile, Daya Nayak’s life has long fascinated filmmakers. RGV himself produced the Nana Patekar-starrer “Ab Tak Chhappan” (2004), which drew inspiration from Nayak’s life. His life and career also influenced films such as N. Chandra’s “Kagaar”, the Kannada movie “Encounter Daya Nayak”, and the Telugu movie “Golimaar”. While those films were inspired by select chapters of his life, “Police Company” has been described as a definitive, full-fledged biopic of one of the most recognisable officers associated with Mumbai’s campaign against organised crime in the 1990s and early 2000s.

Notably, For Harshvardhan Rane, “Police Company” marks another significant feature in his career and a dream collaboration with one of his favourite directors. The star, who has been riding high following the ticket-window success of last year’s “Ek Deewane Ki Deewaniyat”, has several exciting projects lined up. He will next feature in Milap Zaveri’s action drama “Uniform”, followed by Omung Kumar’s “Silaa”, and will then be seen facing off against John Abraham in Bhav Dhulia’s “Force 3”.

title: Amruta Khanvilkar issues legal warning over reports about her marriage to Himanshu Malhotra
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Last week, several reports about Amruta Khanvilkar and Himanshu Malhotra’s marriage started doing the rounds. Some reports claimed that the couple had been separated for the past 18 months. Amid the growing speculation and media coverage, Amruta shared a statement from her legal team on Instagram in a joint collaboration with Himanshu.

Adding to this, The statement, which is effective from August 10, 2026, specifically addresses the circulation of content concerning the star and her personal life. It reads, “Effective from 10 August 2026”. The statement further read, “It has come to our attention that certain online, social media and digital platforms are circulating content concerning Ms. Amruta Khanvilkar and her personal life, which is baseless, defamatory and/or in violation of her privacy.”

Meanwhile, The legal team also acknowledged the right to freedom of expression while warning against the circulation of unverified claims and misleading information. “While the right to freedom of expression is respected, any misuse of such freedom to publish, circulate or share defamatory statements, rumours, unverified allegations or misleading information concerning Ms. Amruta Khanvilkar will be taken seriously,” it shared.
Notably, A post shared by Amruta Khanvilkar (@amrutakhanvilkar)

As per the latest buzz, The statement also indicated that legal action could follow in cases where there is sufficient evidence as it added, “Wherever supported by available evidence, appropriate legal action will be initiated against the individuals, entities or organisations responsible for creating, publishing, circulating or sharing such content, in accordance with applicable law.”

In further updates, The legal team went on to continue, “All such instances are being monitored and documented for appropriate legal recourse.” The statement concluded with, “Legal Team Ms. Amruta Khanvilkar”

On top of that, The latest development comes amid continued public interest in Amruta Khanvilkar and Himanshu Malhotra’s marriage. This is not the first time that their relationship has come under scrutiny, with the couple having previously spoken about their unconventional marriage and their equation. Despite their conversations about their relationship, speculation surrounding an alleged separation has continued to surface from time to time.
With the latest statement, Amruta’s legal team has made it clear that content concerning her personal life is being monitored and that appropriate legal recourse may be pursued wherever applicable.

title: Lucky Ali says he travels with a burial cloth, is prepared to die: ‘Jaha bhi marr jau, wahi gaad do mujhe’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

For many of us, Lucky Ali has been a part of our childhood, and the new generation is also discovering his timeless tracks like "O Sanam", "Ek Pal Ka Jeena," "Na Tum Jano Na Hum," "Dekha Hai Aise Bhi," "Safarnama" and more. The singer, who continues to serenade his followers at concerts, got emotional at his recent concert.

Adding to this, Lucky Ali spoke about death at a recent concert. 'Travel with burial cloth' During his concert, the 67-year-old singer spoke about the inevitability of death and how he is prepared for it. A video from the concert, which Ali later shared on his Instagram handle, is now going widely shared. Addressing the crowd, Lucky spoke about the love he receives from his followers and shared, “I know, I love you all too. But one day, I have to go, na. I am not preparing you for it, but I am prepared, actually," he shared.

Meanwhile, Ali shared a personal detail about how he travels as he opened up that he keeps his Ihram, a piece of cloth traditionally used as burial clothing, with him all the time when he travels. “Whenever I travel, I travel with my Ihram, which is my burial cloth. Jaha bhi marr jau, wahi gaad do mujhe (Wherever I die, bury me there)," he shared.
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Lucky Ali (@officialluckyali)

As per the latest buzz, Followers got emotional after hearing Ali's personal detail. A comment read, "But until you alive don't give up." Another comment read, "Travelling with ihram shows the faith u carry in your heart . May Allah bless you with a long healthy life and a even better hereafter.. ameen." One more comment read, "I refuse to accept this reality. Its still late 90s & Im watching ur song on dd & u are young forever. Mentally stuck there❤️"

In further updates, The singer's candid comments about death and his preparedness for it left many followers emotional, with several taking to social media to express their love for the veteran singer. Many followers also recalled his songs and the nostalgia associated with his music, while others wished him a long and healthy life.
On top of that, Apart from being a much-loved singer, Lucky Ali has also acted in films, but he eventually stepped away from the mainstream movie industry.
In an interview with Navbharat Times last year, the singer spoke about quitting acting and playback singing to go into independent music fully.

title: Excel Entertainment turns 25: Farhan Akhtar, Ritesh Sidhwani announce Excel Origins to back filmmakers under 30
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Excel Entertainment completes 25 years as Ritesh Sidhwani and Farhan Akhtar launch Excel Origins to discover and support filmmakers under 30.

Adding to this, Sidhwani and Akhtar revealed the initiative through their social media posts, looking back at the journey that began with Dil Chahta Hai . The 2001 movie, which marked Farhan Akhtar’s directorial debut, went on to become an influential coming-of-age movie and established Excel Entertainment’s interest in backing fresh voices.

Meanwhile, Reflecting on the company’s beginnings, the duo noted that they were 26 when they started Excel Entertainment. “We didn’t have all the answers but we had an idea we believed in, the courage to take risks and the tenacity to make it happen,” they shared.

Notably, With Excel Origins, the filmmakers now intend to extend that philosophy to emerging talent. The initiative will focus on filmmakers under 30, with the aim of identifying writers and directors with distinctive voices and supporting them in developing original stories.
As per the latest buzz, The initiative will explore projects across genres and formats, while also creating opportunities for emerging actors and other creative talent.
In further updates, A post shared by Excel Entertainment (@excelmovies)
On top of that, Looking ahead, Sidhwani and Akhtar shared the next 25 years would include “Excel empowering young, aspiring filmmakers with bold ideas and the courage to tell stories differently.”
The initiative, they added, is ultimately about investing in “where cinema goes next.”

body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

HBO's "House of the Dragon" launched Season 3 with the stirring Battle of the Gullet in June and put an exclamation point on a critics-silencing season with the Battle of Tumbleton in an enthralling season finale on Sunday, Aug. 9.

Adding to this, With the Dance of the Dragons hitting fever pitch, Team Blacks leader, Queen Rhaenyra Targaryen (Emma D'Arcy), seeks to hold onto power with the might of six dragons backing her armies in the bitter, ever complicated succession battle.

Meanwhile, Daemon Targaryen (Matt Smith) leads the Blacks against Greens leader Ormund Hightower (James Norton) at the strategic market town of Tumbleton. The utter carnage that follows brings major developments for all the main characters still on the chessboard — and many gruesome deaths by dragon fire, boiling oil, spikes and even catapults. Because what action fan doesn't appreciate a good catapult crushing?

Notably, Here's where the key characters ended up after the 75-minute Season 3 finale (now streaming on HBO Max) , heading into what the creators promise will be the fourth and final season of the "Game of Thrones" prequel series, expected in 2028.

As per the latest buzz, Debaucherous dragonrider Ulf White (Tom Bennett) stumbles into playing a major role in the final battle with his dragon Silverwing. After being publicly humiliated by Daemon Targaryen and lured to switch sides (with his dragon) to the Greens by Ormund Hightower, party animal Ulf is still drunk and MIA when the battle starts. Ormund hunts Ulf down personally and pulls him out of the public latrine with his pants down. After receiving his final kicking, Ulf breaks and goes dragon-rogue. Flying over the battle, Ulf directs Silverwing's fire on both armies seemingly indiscriminately.
In further updates, To be fair, Ulf did promise Ormund, "They will burn" — without specifying exactly who "they" were.
On top of that, Finale status: Ulf turns from ass to villain. How long will that last?
Ormund gets his comeuppance for his plotting and evildoing, with his final dastardly act being lining scores of innocent children around the Tumbleton city gates as human shields for dragons.

title: Graphic India, Sadhguru join hands for animated epic 'Shiva: The Adiyogi'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mumbai, Graphic India, the studio behind animated mythology franchise "The Legend of Hanuman", has joined hands with Isha Foundation founder Sadhguru for an animated feature movie on Shiva titled "Shiva: The Adiyogi".

Adding to this, Graphic India, Sadhguru join hands for animated epic 'Shiva: The Adiyogi' The epic movie, based on a story by Sadhguru and award-winning creator Sharad Devarajan, will explore Shiva as the Adiyogi, or the first Yogi, and the circumstances that led him to share his knowledge with humanity, a press rollout shared.

Meanwhile, The story will traverse themes of love, loss, wrath and awakening, moving from the darkness before creation to the peaks of Kailash. It will also depict the rampage of Veerabhadra, described as a being born from grief, alongside the devotion of two women who seek to prevent Shiva from retreating from existence.

Notably, "In the Yogic culture, Shiva is not seen as a god. For us, Shiva is the Adiyogi – the first Yogi, and the Adiguru – the first Guru. For the first time in the history of humanity, Shiva the Adiyogi introduced the idea that the simple laws of nature are not permanent restrictions," Sadhguru shared.

As per the latest buzz, "If one is willing to strive, one can go beyond all limitations and attain to liberation. Breaking the laws of physical nature is spiritual process. In this sense, we are outlaws, and Shiva is the ultimate outlaw," he added.

In further updates, Devarajan, who is the movie's producer, co-creator and writer and co-founder of Graphic India, shared the project gave him an opportunity to explore the origins of wisdom through a cinematic canvas combining mythology, romance and large-scale action.
On top of that, "This is the story of how wisdom itself was born, and why it was shared with humanity," he shared.

"As a storyteller, there is no greater canvas, a cosmic love story, a tale of devastating loss, and action on a scale no epic has ever attempted. Armies of gods fall before a warrior born of pure grief. A blind conqueror storms the gates of heaven. A third eye opens and burns desire itself out of existence," Devarajan shared.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The wait is officially over! Salman Khan has verified that the highly anticipated international action thriller 7 Dogs which will hit theaters in India on August 21, 2026. Already creating hype across Arab countries with its action and massive stunts, the movie will soon be in Indian theatres. The movie features special appearances of Salman and Sanjay Dutt .

Adding to this, Salman Khan in a still from Saudi Arabia movie 7 Dogs. What Salman Khan shared In his Instagram story on August 10, the star shared the new trailer cut for the Indian audiences. Along with that, towards the end of it, you hear the Hindi dubbing of the Egyptian lead actors of the movie, Karim Abdel Aziz and Ahmed Ezz.
Meanwhile, One of the biggest attractions for Indian audiences is the presence of Salman and Sanjay in 7 Dogs. They will be seen in special appearances along with the Italian star Monica Bellucci.

Notably, The movie has been directed by Adil El Arbi and Bilall Fallah, the filmmaking duo behind Bad Boys for Life and Bad Boys: Ride or Die. They have also worked on Marvel's Ms. Marvel, making 7 Dogs another major action project in their growing international filmography.

As per the latest buzz, The movie has been mounted on an unusually large scale for an Arab-language production. According to GQ Middle East, the movie's reported budget is nearly $40 million and is among the most expensive films to come out of the Arab region. Much of the production was filmed at Al-Hosn Big Time Studios in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with the makers putting a strong focus on practical action, stunts and real explosions.

In further updates, The biggest claim to fame, however, is a sequence that has collected 7 Dogs a place in the Guinness World Records. The movie features what has been recognised as the largest movie stunt explosion, with the blast equivalent to 170.7 tonnes of TNT. The feat surpassed the previous record associated with the James Bond films Spectre and No Time to Die.

On top of that, International Interpol agent Khalid Al-Azzazi succeeds in apprehending Ghali Abu Dawood, a key figure in the secret worldwide crime syndicate nicknamed 7 Dogs. However, when the syndicate appears a year later dealing in a new deadly drug called Pink Lady in the Middle East, Khalid finds himself working alongside the only person who understands the inner workings of the syndicate. Their covert operation spans through several cities around the world.

Salman Khan will next star in Vamshi Paidipally's action thriller, tentatively titled SVC63. The project will mark his first on-screen collaboration with South Indian star Nayanthara. Produced by Dil Raju under Sri Venkateswara Creations, the movie has locked in the theatrical rollout for Eid 2027. title: CINTAA hits back at ‘false’ dissolution claims: ‘A 68-year-old institution can't be undermined by misinformation’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The Cine & TV Artistes’ Association ( CINTAA ), one of the Indian entertainment industry’s oldest representative bodies for actors, has strongly rejected claims that its Executive Committee has been dissolved, terming such assertions incorrect, misconceived and unsupported by the Association’s Constitution.

Adding to this, Poonam Dhillon is the President of CINTAA. 'EC shall dissolve only when more than 50 per cent members resign' According to CINTAA , its Constitution provides that the Executive Committee can stand dissolved only when more than 50 per cent of its elected members resign. The Association maintains that no such situation has arisen and that its Executive Committee therefore remains valid, operational and fully functional.

Meanwhile, CINTAA further shared that vacancies arising in the Executive Committee have been filled in accordance with its constitutional framework by inducting eligible members who were next in line on the basis of the voting count.

Notably, Adv. Suvigya Vidyarthi, Legal Counsel representing CINTAA, shared, “The version which has been circulating that the EC of CINTAA is dissolved is totally wrong, misconceived and lacks any judicial sanctity. As per the Constitution of CINTAA, the EC shall dissolve only when more than 50 per cent of the elected members of the EC resign, which is not the case at hand. FWICE has now jumped into the fray and, in CINTAA’s considered view, has sought to assume powers that are neither known to nor recognised under CINTAA’s constitutional framework. Acting, as we understand it, at the behest of certain disgruntled individuals, it has issued directions which CINTAA considers wholly untenable and contrary to the Constitution of the Association. Such attempts cannot determine or override the internal governance of an autonomous trade union functioning under its own Constitution."

As per the latest buzz, He added, “The Executive Committee of CINTAA remains very much in existence and continues to function for the welfare of artistes and for the protection and strengthening of the rights of vulnerable actors. CINTAA will take all appropriate steps available to it to safeguard the autonomy of the Association, uphold its Constitution and protect the larger interests of its members."

In further updates, CINTAA maintained that disagreements, resignations or changes within an organisation cannot, by themselves, be used to erase either its constitutional structure or its institutional legitimacy. In a strongly worded public notice, CINTAA shared, “All concerned are hereby informed that some confusion is being sought to be created by some disgruntled members of CINTAA for oblique motives. Our Union is fully operational and functional through its EC. Take note. The Executive Committee, CINTAA."

On top of that, The organisation has reiterated that its doors remain open to its members and that its work continues uninterrupted. CINTAA further emphasised that the organisation remains operational and that its Executive Committee remains in place. It maintained that its 68-year mandate to stand up for actors continues, regardless of the ongoing disagreements or developments surrounding its internal functioning.

CINTAA's latest statement comes amid the ongoing dispute over its Executive Committee and the claims surrounding its status. It was reported that 8 elected members of the Executive Committee have resigned from their respective offices.In a joint resignation letter, they alleged that the functioning of the association had increasingly become concentrated around CINTAA President Poonam Dhillon and Senior Vice President Padmini Kolhapure, along with a section of other Executive Committee members.

title: Interview | Bobby Beauty Parlour director Shashwat Dwivedi on Imtiaz Ali and Anurag Kashyap presenting his short film
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Within the span of 20 minutes, Shashwat Dwivedi’s short movie Bobby Beauty Parlour establishes a stirring tale between two female friends. It follows childhood best friends Eelu and Manu, who spend their last hours together inside a neighborhood beauty parlour, awaiting a new chapter in their lives. It is a bittersweet ode to small-town aspirations and friendships packed in a coming-of-age story.

Adding to this, Shashwat Dwivedi's short movie Bobby Beauty Parlour has been presented by Imtiaz Ali and Anurag Kashyap. In an exclusive chat with Hindustan Times, director Shashwat Dwivedi sat down to talk about how the movie took shape, and how the unusual pairing of Anurag Kashyap and Imtiaz Ali came together to present it.

Meanwhile, Talking about the movie, Shashwat begins, “The origin was a bunch of things coming together. My co-writer Janhavi Ashthana, who is the producer and the cinematographer of the movie and me wanted to make something, since the time we were working together on Anurag Kashyap's Kennedy . We were also trying to go independent, and it was she who told me about this story and if I would be interested in writing and directing that.”

Notably, “One of the reasons why she asked me to write and direct was because the story in her mind was about these two female characters, and the only male part was rather unpleasant. So she wanted to compensate for that (smiles)! But when I got the story I realised that there was no need for compensation at all. I came in and made him an even worse character! Because some experiences are very objectively through, and even if I am not a woman… and not experienced that, but I am on either side of it. I have seen my male friends behave with girls like that, and I knew that the story was coming from a very personal and true place. So all I had to do was take that inspiration, use my own experiences of growing up… of not being sure of what life entails, and build on that. Both our actors, Adrija Sinha and Parul Rana, were also very involved in writing their characters. So that's how it came to be,” he adds.
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Short Flips (@ohshortflips)

In further updates, Two of India's most acclaimed directors, Imtiaz Ali and Anurag Kashyap , came on board to present the short movie. Talking about the collaboration, Shashwat calls it ‘unbelievable’ still. He shares, “When I was in movie school, I used to read Imtiaz Ali's screenplays and my screenwriting teacher was a huge Imtiaz Ali fan. So by extension the whole class was an Imtiaz Ali fan. His filmography really grew on me, the way he treats his characters… it is so real. It is a commercial movie but it will always feel so philosophical, which is almost a sin in commercial cinema! One of the things that I really love about his films is how he goes deep into the story and does not mind his characters feeling lost for a while… He was one of the biggest inspiration for me and I still haven't sat down with him and had a chat.”

On top of that, Shashwat adds that the filmmaker behind Rockstar, Tamasha and the of late rolled out Main Vaapas Aaunga does not know how much he looks up to him. He adds that when he had first come to Mumbai, it was on the top of his list to work under the filmmaker. But as fate would have it, Shashwat went on to work under Anurag Kashyap, who has remained a close friend of Ali for years.

“I was younger when some of Anurag Kashyap's films were releasing and I was taken aback because I had grown up watching commercial Bollywood films, and then suddenly a Gangs of Wasseypur comes and I wonder how do I process it… the difference is with Imtiaz sir I have learnt everything without working with him and from Anurag sir I have learnt everything while working with him. Since 2021, I have been working with him, but he has been a solid support. He has always been such a rock to me and is available whenever there is need,” he concludes.

Notably, The resigning members alleged that several decisions were being taken without adequate consultation with, or approval from, the Executive Committee.

As per the latest buzz, The letter further alleges that Dhillon and Kolhapure visited government offices accompanied by privately engaged lawyers, who were allegedly introduced as CINTAA lawyers without the authority or sanction of the Executive Committee.

title: Manoj Muntashir reacts to AR Rahman’s Chhaava propaganda remark: ‘He must have read the script’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Lyricist Manoj Muntashir of late reacted to AR Rahman's past statement, hinting at not getting work due to his religious identity. The writer challenged Rahman's claim and even suggested that the music director might not be getting work perhaps because he hasn't maintained good relations with people in the industry.

Adding to this, Manoj Muntashir dismisses AR Rahman's claim of discrimination in the industry, 'Maybe songs haven't worked in the last few years' In conversation with Shubhankar Mishra on his YouTube channel, Manoj questioned Rahman's claim and shared that the nation has seen many legends who were Muslims. He also shared that Rahman is himself a legend and achieved the zenith due to his work in the country.

Meanwhile, He shared, "When Mohd Azharuddin become captain of the Indian Cricket team, when a Muslim becomes the President of India, when a legend like AR Rahman...who despite his religious identity...there is no bigger name than him in this country. Why didn't he ask this question, 'Why me?' or 'Why a Muslim?' Today because of some reason you feel that you are getting less work than why shouldn't we look for other reasons. It might be that we have not maintained good relations with people. Maybe the songs haven't worked in the last few years. There can be so many other reasons. I don't understand what is the reason behind hurting the social fabric of this nation suddenly. But whenever, I will meet him, I will ask him this. He does not mind an open dialogue. "

Notably, Manoj also reacted to Rahman calling Vicky Kaushal-starrer Chhaava a propaganda movie despite giving the music of the movie. The writer strongly believes that Rahman shouldn't have agreed to do the movie in the first place if he thought that it was a propaganda movie.

As per the latest buzz, He shared, "He shouldn't have been a part of that movie. It is not like you hadn’t heard the script before agreeing to work in it. You suddenly started composing music for it? He must have read the script. Okay so it was a propaganda movie and you didn’t want to do it... but after doing the movie and calling it a propaganda, I do not understand this, sorry."

In further updates, In an earlier interaction with BBC, Rahman was asked whether there is ‘prejudice within the Hindi movie landscape’ and if he has faced any discrimination. Responding to the same, he had shared, “Maybe I never get to know of this, maybe it was concealed but I didn’t feel any of this. Maybe in the past eight years because a power shift has happened and people who are not creative have the power now. It might be a communal thing also… but it is not in my face. It comes to me as Chinese whispers that they booked you but the music company went ahead and hired their 5 composers. I say good, I have more time to chill with my family. I am not in search for work. I don’t want to go in search for work. I want work to come to me; my sincerity to earn work. Whatever I deserve, I get.”

On top of that, Manoj's remarks have once again brought attention to Rahman's earlier comments about his experiences within the Hindi movie industry. While Rahman had spoken about the possibility of prejudice and a shift in the industry, Manoj has questioned whether other professional factors could have played a role in the music director's work opportunities.
The comments also come amid renewed discussion around Chhaava, with Manoj offering a contrasting view on Rahman's criticism of the movie despite the music director having worked on the project.

title: Delhi HC protects Tabu from identity misuse after actor complains of AI-generated obscene content
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The Delhi High Court has granted an ex-parte interim injunction protecting Bollywood star Tabu from unauthorised use of her name, image, voice, photographs and other personality attributes, including through Artificial Intelligence, deepfakes, face morphing and other digital technologies.

Adding to this, Tabu went to court seeking protection of her personality rights. (Instagram/ Tabu) 'Delhi HC orders removal of objectionable content relating to Tabu' Justice Jyoti Singh, who heard a petition filed by Tabu , directed major digital platforms including Google , Meta, X and Reddit to remove or disable access to a large number of URLs allegedly carrying unauthorised and objectionable content relating to Tabu.

Meanwhile, The Court's order came on Tabu's suit seeking protection of her personality and publicity rights. The star had alleged that her identity was being commercially exploited online through fake event-booking accounts, unauthorised merchandise, fabricated statements and AI-generated or manipulated obscene content.

Notably, The Court observed that Tabu's name and stage name 'Tabu', along with her image, voice, likeness and other personality attributes, have acquired unique distinctiveness and are instantly associated with her by the public.

As per the latest buzz, Justice Singh held that Tabu had made out a prima facie case for grant of an ex-parte ad-interim injunction and that the balance of convenience lay in her favour. The Court further found that she was likely to suffer irreparable harm if interim protection was not granted.

In further updates, The Court noted that personality rights have previously been recognised and protected by the Delhi High Court in cases including D.M. Entertainment v. Baby Gift House, Anil Kapoor v. Simply Life India and Jaikishan Kakubhai Saraf v. Peppy Store.

On top of that, It shared unauthorised use of a famous person's name, image or other distinctive attributes for commercial purposes can amount to infringement, dilute the individual's unique identity and result in unearned commercial gain by third parties.

A significant aspect of the case was Tabu's allegation that AI-generated obscene images, videos and GIFs were being circulated online by manipulating excerpts from her films, interviews and public appearances.

title: X replaces ‘misaligned’ revenue sharing program with Original Content Rewards
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

X replaces ‘misaligned’ revenue sharing program with Original Content Rewards Anthony Ha 9:34 AM PDT · August 8, 2026 X, the social media platform now owned by Elon Musk’s SpaceX, is shaking up how it pays influencers and creators.

Adding to this, In announcing the change , the company shared it will be winding down its existing Revenue Sharing program and replacing it with something called Original Content Rewards. X will stop accepting new Revenue Sharing participants, while existing participants will continue earning money through September 7.

Meanwhile, What counts as original content? X shared it can include original reporting and analysis, photos and videos created by the poster, or memes and graphics they’ve designed themselves. Commentary also counts, but “if your content regularly incorporates material created by others, you’ll need to contribute meaningful original value for it to qualify under our original content guidelines.”

Notably, The company also included examples of posts that won’t count as original, such as those just copied over from another account, downloaded from one account and re-uploaded to your own, or reposting content “without meaningful transformation.”

As per the latest buzz, This announcement follows repeated attempts by X to reform the Revenue Sharing program, for example by reducing payments to aggregators and “clickbait” accounts in April . But these efforts have also prompted complaints from popular accounts profiting from the current system; Musk even reversed some of those changes (giving a creator’s local audience more weight when calculating payouts) after a backlash.
In further updates, In a post about the new changes , X’s Allegra Jacchia wrote that the existing program “had reached a point where its incentives were misaligned.”

On top of that, “Creators should be focused on bringing net new content to the platform instead of maximizing payouts,” she shared. “We could have kept adding more rules and exceptions, but ultimately the better decision was to start fresh and build a program designed from day one to reward originality.”
Jacchia added that X be “continue refining the program, improving our models, and raising the bar over time.”

Kumar took this opportunity to take a jibe at Udit over the widely shared concert video in which he was seen kissing female followers.

Meanwhile, The Aashiqui singer shared, “Nahi mereko ko koi chumma wumma nahi khaya. Na maine kisi ko khaya. Na toh me chumma dia, na liya. Maine woh sab nahi kiya (No, nobody came and kissed me. Nor did I kiss anyone. I neither gave nor received a kiss. I didn’t do any of that)."

Notably, During the same interaction, Kumar spoke about his friendship with Udit. While he admitted that they would compete with each other back in the day, but now they share a good equation because they have nothing to lose.

As per the latest buzz, In 2025, videos from Udit Narayan's live performance went widely shared, showing him kissing his female followers as they came to click selfies with him during the performance. One moment drew the strongest reaction when a female fan leaned towards Udit, wanting to kiss him on the cheek, and the singer turned his face and their lips touched. In further updates, This led to more clips of Udit being unearthed, which showed him interacting and getting close to female singers and followers. The singer later addressed the backlash and defended his actions.

title: Delhivery posts Rs 2,931 Cr revenue in Q1 FY27; profit declines 65%
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:
New Update Logistics company Delhivery reported a 27.8% year-on-year increase in revenue in Q1 FY27, while its profit declined sharply during the quarter.

Adding to this, Delhivery's revenue from operations grew to Rs 2,931 crore rupees in Q1 FY27 from Rs 2,294 crore rupees in Q1 FY26, according to its financial statements filed with the National Stock Exchange (NSE).

Meanwhile, The company primarily earns revenue from its logistics services, including warehousing, last-mile delivery, and the design and deployment of logistics management systems. Other income declined 12.3% to Rs 114 crore rupees in Q1 FY27 from Rs 130 crore rupees in the year-ago quarter. As a result, the company's total income rose 25.6% to Rs 3,045 crore rupees from Rs 2,424 crore rupees in Q1 FY26.

Notably, Freight handling and servicing costs remained Delhivery's largest expense, accounting for 71.45% of total expenses. The cost increased 31.4% to Rs 2,152 crore rupees in Q1 FY27 from Rs 1,638 crore rupees in the year-ago quarter.

As per the latest buzz, Employee benefit expenses increased 21.9% to Rs 429 crore rupees from Rs 352 crore rupees, while depreciation rose 28.6% to Rs 189 crore rupees from Rs 147 crore rupees. Finance costs remained flat at Rs 34 crore rupees, whereas other expenses climbed 33.5% to Rs 207 crore rupees from Rs 155 crore rupees.
In further updates, The company's total expenses rose 29.4% to Rs 3,012 crore rupees in Q1 FY27 from Rs 2,327 crore rupees in Q1 FY26.

On top of that, Despite the strong growth in revenue, Delhivery's profit declined 64.8% to Rs 32 crore rupees in Q1 FY27 from Rs 91 crore rupees in Q1 FY26. Indian equity markets are expected to open on a mildly negative note, with Gift Nifty trading around 24,662, down by 86 points, indicating weak opening cues for domestic indices. Global markets are trading mixed as investors remain cautious ahead of key U.S. economic data and continue to assess the implications of recent trade-related developments. Meanwhile, crude oil prices have edged higher amid persistent geopolitical tensions, which may keep market sentiment subdued and lead to a cautious start for domestic equities.

Adding to this, Rupee weakened against the US dollar in the previous session, depreciating 16 paise to settle at 95.24. The currency came under pressure due to a slight recovery in the US Dollar Index, modest gains in US Treasury yields and continued foreign fund outflows. During the day, the rupee opened at 95.13 and traded in a range of 95.12 to 95.24 before ending at its weakest level of the session.

Meanwhile, Forex traders shared softer crude oil prices limited the downside for rupee by easing concerns around India's import bill. According to Mirae Asset ShareKhan analyst Anuj Choudhary, expectations of a possible US-Iran agreement could support rupee, although any rebound in the dollar index or Treasury yields may restrict gains.

Notably, According to analysts domestic equities have found support from multiple macroeconomic developments during the previous session. Vinod Nair, head of research at Geojit Investments, shared crude oil prices and intensified diplomatic efforts to restore stability in the Middle East improved investor confidence.

As per the latest buzz, He added that the Reserve Bank of India's decision to maintain the repo rate at 5.25% for the fourth consecutive meeting, along with its neutral policy stance and constructive economic outlook, encouraged selective buying in banking and energy stocks. The central bank also marginally raised its GDP growth forecast for the current financial year to 6.7% while trimming its inflation projection to 5%. However, policymakers maintained that future rate decisions would remain dependent on incoming economic data and inflation trends.

In further updates, Benchmark equity indices ended on a mixed note in the previous trading session, with BSE Sensex outperforming NSE Nifty as buying in heavyweight stocks offset broader caution. title: Jude Anthany Joseph clarifies Mohanlal ‘secondary artist’ remark, says Ayushmann Khurrana ‘not at fault’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Malayalam filmmaker Jude Anthany Joseph of late stirred up row after he shared that he left a Bollywood movie starring Ayushmann Khurrana midway through discussions after he felt disrespected when Mohanlal was called a 'secondary artist'. Now, the filmmaker has shared a photo with Ayushmann and clarified that the remark was not made by the star.

Adding to this, Jude Anthany Joseph shared a photo with Ayushmann Khurrana. 'The comment had nothing to do with Ayushmann' Jude shared a photo with Ayushmann and showered him with love and lauded his talent. He also issued a clarification, stating that the problematic remark about superstar Mohanlal was made by a producer and not the Dum Laga Ke Haisha star. He wrote in the caption, “Wonderful catching up with Ayushmann today ❤️ Just to clarify, my Mohanlal Sir comment was about the producer and had nothing to do with him. Nothing but respect between us. Hope we get to work together soon! ❤️”

Meanwhile, In the caption, Jude also mentioned that Ayushmann was excited about the project, but it got shelved. He wrote, “He was so happy with the Mohanlal sir script, and unfortunately it didn’t work out. It was definitely not his fault that it didn’t happen. But I’m genuinely happy that I got to meet an star with so much talent and calibre. Hope we get to work together someday. ❤️”
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Jude Anthany Joseph (@judeanthanyjoseph)

As per the latest buzz, Ayushmann responded to Jude's post with an equally heartwarming message. He wrote, “I’m a fan of your work and I hope that I get the opportunity to work with you soon. I have the utmost respect for Mohanlal sir’s work. He is a legend. I hope I’m worthy enough to share screen space with him someday. 🙏🏽”

In further updates, During a recent interaction with Club FM, Jude shared that he chose to walk out of a project with Ayushmann Khurrana as the lead after his demand to confirm Mohanlal's role in the movie was taken lightly. The Malayalam superstar was also referred to as a ‘secondary artist’, which the director found insulting.

On top of that, He shared, “The basic script was almost complete. We had also discussed the story with the production house. At that time, Lal sir had a role in the story. It was an important role. However, they asked me to complete the screenplay first. At that point, I put forward a demand to them. I told them that I could complete the script, but my condition was that Lal sir should be verified for the project. They responded by saying, ‘First, we need to like the script. Only then will we think about the secondary artists.’”

Jude's latest clarification makes it clear that his disagreement was with the production house and not Ayushmann. His post also highlighted the mutual respect between the filmmaker and star, with both expressing hope that they can collaborate on a project in the future.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Mumbai, Mumbai Police have arrested Bollywood filmmaker Shakeel Noorani after a 33-year-old aspiring star accused him of raping and threatening her, officials shared on Monday.

Adding to this, Filmmaker Shakeel Noorani held after aspiring star alleges rape The 73-year-old accused was traced to his farmhouse in Mahabaleshwar hill station, located more than 200 km from Mumbai, on Saturday after he went into hiding following the registration of a First Information Report against him, they shared.

In further updates, When she regained consciousness, Noorani showed her an intimate video on his mobile phone and allegedly threatened to circulate it if she approached the police or informed her family.

title: ‘She hurls abuses and I take it’: Govinda on Sunita Ahuja’s cheating claims, asks why bad-mouths him for success
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Sunita Ahuja has often publicly spoken about Bollywood star Govinda's alleged extramarital affairs and infidelity with his co-stars. In a recent interaction, Govinda addressed those allegations and refused such claims, while also questioning Sunita for bad mouthing him to gain success.

Adding to this, Sunita Ahuja and Govinda have been married since 1987. 'She hurls abuses and I take it' In conversation with ANI, Govinda admitted that though Sunita had made such claims in the past, she is responsible for bringing up the kids in his household. He shared, "Itne pyaar se gali deti hai mujhe aur main khata bhi hoon unke haath se (She affectionately hurls abuses at me, and I just take it in stride). I feel that wherever people are and whatever roles the Almighty has assigned them—the specific niche they occupy—we wouldn't have achieved success without them being there. We simply wouldn't be who we are. She has a rightful claim over the many children in our family who have now grown up. She was also kind to them.”

Meanwhile, Govinda hinted at how Sunita has gained attention after she started speaking about him in public. He shared, "There are many things that remain unexpressed—things that can never be put into words. If I were to offer just a glimpse of these matters from the outside, would there really be a need to cast aspersions to create a distance? People often view that as an escape. Is it essential to say bad mouth your own people to gain success? That is a bit easy. Sunita does it tactfully. She offers four words of praise or perhaps the praise comes naturally and then voice a criticism. I see more love in that."

Notably, Sunita was a contestant on the of late concluded show Lock Upp 2. During her brief stint on the show, Sunita spoke about Govinda's alleged affairs. She shared, “In love, you should be able to tolerate everything. Chi Chi had so many affairs in his life; well, heroes and heroines do have such things. I think that after standing by Chi Chi for so many years, I deserve to have a son like him.”

As per the latest buzz, Govinda and Sunita Ahuja got married in 1987 in a private ceremony. At the time, he was already a Bollywood star. They kept their marriage under wraps for nearly two years for the sake of his career and made it public after the birth of their daughter, Tina Ahuja. Later, they had their son, Yashvardhan Ahuja.

title: Amruta Khanvilkar issues legal warning over reports of separation from Himanshu Malhotra: ‘Baseless and defamatory’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Amruta Khanvilkar has taken a stand against media reports pertaining to her marriage with star Himanshu Malhotra , issuing a legal notice that warns the media and all social networking sites against indulging in the circulation of defamatory information regarding their personal life. Their lawyers issued a strongly worded notice, making it clear that any unverified claims or invasion of privacy could invite legal action. This notice was issued soon after reports were rolled out stating that Amruta and Himanshu have been living apart from each other for the last 18 months.

Adding to this, Amruta Khanvilkar issues legal notice over marriage reports with Himanshu Malhotra, warns against defamatory claims. Amruta Khanvilkar's legal team issues warning In a statement dated August 10, 2026, Amruta's legal representatives addressed the reports in a strong statement which read, “ It has come to our attention that certain online, social media and digital platforms are circulating content concerning Ms. Amruta Khanvilkar and her personal life, which is baseless, defamatory and/or in violation of her privacy.”

Meanwhile, The legal team acknowledged the importance of freedom of expression but drew a line at what it described as defamatory or misleading reporting. It added, “While the right to freedom of expression is respected, any misuse of such freedom to publish, circulate or share defamatory statements, rumours, unverified allegations or misleading information concerning Ms. Amruta Khanvilkar will be taken seriously.”

Notably, The statement also warned that those found responsible could face legal consequences. It shared, “ Wherever supported by available evidence, appropriate legal action will be initiated against the individuals, entities or organisations responsible for creating, publishing, circulating or sharing such content, in accordance with applicable law.”

As per the latest buzz, Her team further shared that instances of such content are being tracked and recorded for possible legal action, concluding, “All such instances are being monitored and documented for appropriate legal recourse.”

In further updates, View this post on Instagram Reports claim they have been living separately The legal notice follows a Times of India report stating that Amruta and Himanshu maintained separate addresses for the past 18 months. However, an insider verified that neither a divorce nor a legal separation is currently in the works. Despite living apart, the couple remained on excellent terms. The report also noted that they are still close friends who regularly catch up on both personal and professional matters.

On top of that, Rather than a dramatic falling out, the choice to move into different homes was as per reports a practical one. The report chalked the decision up to a mix of financial realities, shifting career priorities, and family obligations that made living together difficult at this stage. It also shared that the two of them were simply taking some space to evaluate their future.

It was on the sets of India's Best Cinestars Ki Khoj in 2004 where Amruta Khanvilkar and Himanshu Malhotra first met. They fell in love and after many years of being together, they got married in January 2015. That same year, Amruta and Himanshu participated in Nach Baliye 7 and ended up winning the dance reality show.

title: Pankaj Tripathi says Mirzapur was a 'leave me alone’ watch on OTT, will enter 'party mode’ in theatres | Exclusive
body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:

It has rarely happened in Indian cinema that something that began on streaming translates into a wide theatrical rollout. But such is the craze for Mirzapur that after three seasons, the popular show is finishing its journey with a theatrical spinoff. Mirzapur - The Movie is set to hit the screens next month, bringing back beloved characters from the first season.

Adding to this, Pankaj Tripathi will reprise his role as Kaleen Bhaiya in Mirzapur. Ahead of the movie’s grand trailer launch this week, star Pankaj Tripathi opened up on what new audiences can expect from the movie adaptation and his own first take on the movie.

Meanwhile, Mirzapur is set in the eponymous town in UP and deals with the clash between the family of local gangster Akhandanand Tripathi aka Kaleen Bhaiya (Pankaj Tripathi) and the Pandit brothers (Ali Fazal and Jitendra Kumar). The movie adaptation is seen as an origin story of how the clash began, a more elaborate version of what was shown in the first season of the show. However, Pankaj says there is a lot of newness in the movie.

Notably, When asked about what is new in Mirzapur that differentiates it from the show, the star says, “The new thing about the movie—and you actually touched upon this in your question—is the scale. On OTT, you watch on screens ranging from 5 to 100 inches, but now you’ll be watching on a 25-to-28-foot screen. So, the major shift is that you get to see it on the big screen and experience it communally. Until now, watching on OTT was a solitary, private affair; now, you’ll be watching it with an audience.”

As per the latest buzz, The two-time National Award-winning star says that the experience of communal watching will change how people see Mirzapur. “Whenever a performance or art form is experienced communally, the impact changes entirely. Enjoying it in a group creates a unique, shared experience. So, while Mirzapur used to be a "leave me alone” kind of watch, it’s now in "party mode.” The world is the same, the characters are the same, but the story is new, and the experience is much grander,” he says.

In further updates, The star reveals that he has been finishing the dubbing for the movie and is excited by how it has turned out. “I was doing some dubbing work yesterday and really enjoyed what I saw. I even wondered, ‘Is it just because I’m part of the movie that I’m enjoying it so much?’ So, I asked the makers, they’ve been with the project for ten months, whereas I was coming in to dub for the first time. Seeing it myself really ramped up my excitement; I can't wait for the trailer to drop on the 11th,” he adds.

On top of that, Presented by Amazon MGM Studios and Excel Entertainment, Mirzapur: The Movie is directed by Gurmeet Singh, written by Puneet Krishna, and produced by Ritesh Sidhwani and Farhan Akhtar under the banner of Excel Entertainment. The movie is co-produced by Kassim Jagmagia and Vishal Ramchandani. Mirzapur is set for a theatrical rollout in Hindi and Telugu on 4 September 2026.

The movie stars Ali Fazal, Pankaj Tripathi and Divyenndu, while Jitendra Kumar takes over from Vikrant Massey, who played Bablu in the show. Ravi Kishan, Abhishek Banerjee, Rasika Dugal, Mohitt Maalik, Sheeba Chadha, Rajesh Tailang, Pramod Pathak, Shriya Pilgaonkar, Harshita Shekhar Gaur, Shweta Tripathi, and Sonal S Chauhan round off the cast.

title: ‘You didn’t look like a hero’: Govinda recalls blunt advice to Salman Khan during painful phase, urged him to exercise
body: Here's the latest fashion moment turning heads:

Star Govinda of late recalled a conversation with Salman Khan before they began shooting for their 2007 movie Partner, saying he advised the star to work on himself during a difficult phase and told him he would go on to "rule" the movie industry for a decade.

Adding to this, Salman Khan and Govinda in a still from Partner. 'Salman was going through a lot of pain' In conversation with ANI, Govinda shared Salman was dealing with "pain and distress" at the time and had become withdrawn. Govinda shared he decided to speak to him and encouraged him to look beyond his personal troubles.

Meanwhile, "Salman was going through a lot of pain and distress. And when someone is troubled by himself, whether it is because of love, hopes, or expectations, there is no one else who can really cure that. So, he had become very withdrawn. I thought I should introduce him to Satya, so we sat together and had a drink. While we were drinking, I told him, "Salman, you've looked outward enough. Now look within yourself," he told ANI.

Notably, "At that time, I weighed 114 kilos. It was the time when I had just come out of politics. I told him, "By the time I lose weight, I'll already be a character star, right? I'll continue doing the kind of roles I was doing in Partner, I was doing comedy." I told him, "You are the hero, but you don't look like one right now. You look unhappy, you look sad. Come out of this," he added

As per the latest buzz, According to Govinda, Salman then asked him what he should do. The Hero No. 1 star shared he advised Salman to exercise and reminded him of the qualities that made him stand out as a star.

In further updates, "He asked me, "What should I do?" I shared, "Exercise for two or three hours a day. Look at Dharmendra. You are the only hero, after Dharmendra, who has been blessed by God with parents, siblings, a good face and a great personality. You are the only guy who could carry that kind of aura, the kind that makes people look at you and say, 'That's a hero.'"

On top of that, Govinda shared Salman followed his advice and went on to enjoy a successful run in the years that followed. He also recalled telling Salman that he would rule the industry for a decade. "He did it. I told him, "You will rule for 10 years." And he did rule for 10 years."

'Partner,' directed by David Dhawan, starred Salman Khan and Govinda in the lead roles. Rolled out on July 20, 2007, the romantic comedy was a ticket-window success and the pairing of the two actors was well received by the audience. Songs including Do You Wanna Partner, Soni De Nakhre and You're My Love also became popular.

title: R Madhavan reacts to Dhurandhar being called propaganda: ‘Don’t understand how being Indian can be seen as wrong’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star R Madhavan of late addressed the criticism surrounding his films Dhurandhar (2025) and its sequel, Dhurandhar : The Revenge (2026), being called propaganda films by a certain section. The star clapped back at such claims and also questioned why it is wrong to be seen as Indian.

Adding to this, R Madhavan in a still from Aditya Dhar's Dhurandhar. 'What does it mean by ‘being overly Indian’?' During an interaction with Galatta Plus, he spoke about how Dhurandhar was labelled “propaganda” and also spoke about his directorial debut, Rocketry: The Nambi Effect (2022), which many claimed emphasised being Indian. Responding to the same, he shared, “I don’t understand how being an Indian can be seen as a wrong thing. What does it mean by ‘being overly Indian’? I don’t know. Is it not okay to show myself as being ‘too Indian’? I don’t know. That’s not my conditioning; I showed that. This is not even a political statement. Dhurandhar was based in Pakistan. Good and bad things happen there as well, just as much as they do in India. So, I don’t understand what the ‘propaganda’ in it is."

Meanwhile, He added, “In Nambi sir’s (aerospace scientist Nambi Narayanan) case, I only showed what happened in his life. How can I be honest with the story if I am afraid to show who he really is? He is a person who goes to the temple. GD Naidu (inventor and engineer), on the other hand, is a nastik (atheist). So, we can’t show such things (him going to temples) in the movie. I have to be true to that character. Because of that, one can’t say that I don’t believe in god or vice versa. I am an star, and my job is to portray things as they are. My personal opinion is that I want to enhance all the good things about India. That cannot be a crime.”

Notably, Madhavan admitted that from a young age, he was taught that the country is the most important thing and that what we do for it is also very important. He shared that he hasn't spoken ill of any political party, politician or political leader in any of his interviews and has even lauded their achievements irrespective of the political party they belong to.

As per the latest buzz, He admitted that when he has doubts about something, he doesn't talk about it, and he believes that it is his duty to support an elected politician when they become a Prime Minister or a Chief Minister. The star also clarified that, to date, no party — be it in Tamil Nadu or at the national level — has approached him asking him to promote them or inviting him to join them.
In further updates, On the work front, Madhavan's G.D.N. is currently running in theatres. He has Adhirshtasaali and Circle in the pipeline.

title: Govinda recalls ‘kind of’ trying to end his life after mother's death: ‘Realised have to live for my children’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Govinda has opened up about the intense grief he experienced following the death of his mother, Nirmala Devi, revealing that he once entered the Narmada River believing he would "meet" her again.

Adding to this, Govinda recalled the painful memory of losing his mother. 'Felt everything was over' In a conversation with ANI, Govinda recalled being in "tremendous pain" after his mother's demise in 1996 and shared the loss left him feeling that everything was over.
Meanwhile, "I was in a lot of pain. I was in tremendous pain. At that point, I felt that everything was over; that was it," Govinda shared.

Notably, Nirmala Devi, a renowned Hindustani classical vocalist and star, died on June 15, 1996, at the age of 69. Govinda was extremely close to his mother and has often credited her spiritual influence with playing an important role in both his personal and professional life.

As per the latest buzz, Recalling the incident at the Narmada River, the star shared, "So, I was at the Narmada River, I thought I would go a little farther into the river and that I would meet my mother again. So, I went into the river."
In further updates, When asked whether he was trying to commit suicide, Govinda replied, "Kind of. I was deeply attached to my mother. I was too much in love with her."

On top of that, He later explained that he did not view the incident simply in those terms. "That's what the world calls it. People use suicide type of words. We don't really have anything like that. Life never ends. It takes on new faces; It takes on new forms," he shared.
Govinda recalled that a sadhu, whom he now reminisces as Ram Kundal, approached him and helped him come out of the river.

title: Govinda reveals why he stopped working with David Dhawan after 17 films: ‘Jis waqt use aisa laga ki…’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Govinda and filmmaker David Dhawan emerged as one of the hit star-director duos in the 1990s, delivering a string of memorable entertainers that continue to resonate with audiences. From Raja Babu, Coolie No 1 to Hero No 1 and Bade Miyan Chote Miyan , the duo's films became synonymous with comedy, catchy music, and Govinda's unmistakable comic timing.

Adding to this, Govinda reveals why he stopped working with David Dhawan. Govinda reveals why he stopped working with David Dhawan Years after their successful run together came to an end, Govinda has now opened up about why he stopped working with the filmmaker.
Meanwhile, In conversation with ANI, the star shared he believed David had simply reached a stage where he felt the partnership could no longer continue.

Notably, "We did 17 films together. David is like a God's child. Jis waqt use aisa laga ki samay aa gaya hai ki main Govinda ke saath aur aage nahi badh paunga, woh theher gaye (When he felt that the time had come when he could no longer move forward with Govinda, he stopped there). I wanted us to do an 18th and also a 19th movie together, but he didn't do it. So I felt that he was going according to his thinking. I never had any doubt about it," Govinda shared.

As per the latest buzz, The star also acknowledged that he would occasionally get upset with Dhawan, but maintained that their personal bond endured despite their professional association coming to an end.

In further updates, "Sometimes I used to get upset with him. I used to call him, and he would understand. Even now when my topic comes up, he starts crying. He is sincere. He is a good guy," Govinda shared.

On top of that, He also revealed reaching out to David Dhawan after the filmmaker's latest outing, recalling, "Abhi jab unki movie aane se pehle phone kiya tha. Mujhe laga unse mulaqat karni chahiye. Unhone rollout ke baad mujhe call kiya and kaha ki tu apni taklif se bahar nikal. (I called him before his movie's rollout as I felt like I should meet him. He called me after the rollout and told me to get over my troubles)."
Further in the conversation, Govinda also spoke about another collaborator from the most memorable phase of his career, the legendary Kader Khan.

title: Bhumi Pednekar braves flooded Assam roads to distribute solar lights: ‘Everywhere there is water’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bhumi Pednekar is doing her bit for those affected by the devastating Assam floods. The star has shared a video of herself travelling to flood-hit districts of the state to take part in relief efforts and provide aid to those affected by the floods. Bhumi travelled to the flood-hit state with the Bharat Disaster Relief Foundation (BDRF).

Adding to this, Bhumi Pednekar participates in relief effort in Assam. Bhumi takes part in relief effort Bhumi reshared a video by BDRF that shows her travelling in a car in the dark. She says, "The google map is showing that there is a road but everywhere there is water." She is seen distributing solar lights to those affected by the floods. She is also seen talking to Assam flood victims and handing them food and other relief item packets.

Meanwhile, The video shows that even at around 11pm, her surroundings are filled with water. She says in the video that the water level has not gone down for the last three weeks. She explains that this is why they have been distributing solar lights to families, so they can protect themselves from snakes and other reptiles during this time. "It is very difficult. You will have to come and eperience this to know the condition," she shared in the clip.

Notably, She captioned the post, "Doesn’t matter what time of the day, volunteers are there supporting people @bdrf_official. Distributed solar lights to flood-affected families who are struggling with limited access to electricity and safe lighting. For families living in temporary shelters, a light after sunset is more than just a necessity, it brings safety, comfort, and hope."
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Bhumi Satish Pednekkar (@bhumisatishpednekkar)

In further updates, Earlier, Bhumi had shared videos of herself walking through knee-deep water to provide aid to those affected by the floods. In another video, Bhumi is seen arriving at a house surrounded by water in a boat. Not just Bhumi, Randeep Hooda had also participated in the relief effort. title: Jude Anthany Joseph reveals he walked out of Ayushmann Khurrana film after producers called Mohanlal ‘secondary artist’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Malayalam filmmaker Jude Anthany Joseph of late opened up about leaving an Ayushmann Khurrana -starrer movie midway through discussions. Jude shared that he chose to walk out of the project after his demand to confirm Mohanlal's role in the movie was taken lightly. The Malayalam superstar was also referred to as a 'secondary artist' by the production house, a description Jude found insulting to 'one of the finest actors in the country.'

Adding to this, Jude Anthany Joseph was set to make a movie with Ayushmann Khurrana. Jude on quitting Ayushmann Khurrana movie While in conversation with Club FM, the Thudakkam director shared that he was approached by several production houses across movie industrues like Tamil, Telugu for his story, but he chose to develop it with Ayushmann Khurrana as he called the project ‘a proper Bollywood movie’. He shared he had also developed the basic script for the proposed Hindi movie before approaching the production house.

Meanwhile, He shared that Mohanlal had an important character in the story, but the production house wanted him to complete the screenplay before committing to any casting. “The basic script was almost complete. We had also discussed the story with the production house. At that time, Lal sir had a role in the story. It was an important role. However, they asked me to complete the screenplay first. At that point, I put forward a demand to them. I told them that I could complete the script, but my condition was that Lal sir should be verified for the project.”

Notably, However, their choice of words was what rubbed Jude the wrong way. He shared, “They responded by saying, ‘First, we need to like the script. Only then will we think about the secondary artists.’” Jude admitted that he was unhappy with Mohanlal being called a 'secondary artist' by the production house. This was the reason he decided to walk away from the project.

As per the latest buzz, Jude shared that he eventually brought his lawyer into the matter and withdrew from the project. In the end, he also opened up that he made the production house sign a non-disclosure agreement.

In further updates, Jude made his directorial debut with the critically acclaimed Ohm Shanthi Oshaana in 2014. He went on to direct films such as Oru Muthassi Gadha (2016) and Sara's (2021) and short movie No Go Tell. His movie, 2018, received positive reviews and was a massive hit, grossing around ₹ 200 crore rupees. His movie Thudakkam (2016) marked the acting debut of Mohanlal's daughter Vismaya Mohanlal.
