title: Superstar's cousin became a 70s heartthrob after 2 hits, later vanished from Bollywood: Where is Tariq Khan now?
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

He was one of Bollywood’s most recognisable young stars of the 1970s, winning over audiences with his boyish charm, dancing skills and hit songs. After making a striking debut and following it up with another successful movie, he seemed destined for a long innings as a leading man. Yet, at the peak of his career, the star chose to step away from Bollywood and explore an entirely different path.

Adding to this, Aamir Khan's cousin Tariq Khan left Bollywood after not getting substantial work. Tariq Khan's Bollywood journey Tariq Khan comes from a family with deep roots in Hindi cinema. He is the son of Azhar Ali Khan, who was married to Anzie Khan, the sister of Nasir Hussain and Tahir Hussain, who produced several notable films. He is also the cousin of superstar Aamir Khan and filmmaker Mansoor Ali Khan , making him part of one of Bollywood’s best-known movie families.

Meanwhile, While Tariq’s father wanted him to become a doctor, the star was never too interested in academics. He was interested in films and, instead of directly giving him a break, his uncle Nasir Hussain insisted that he assist him in production. This marked the beginning of his journey in the movie industry. He assisted his uncle on Caravan and later, at a party, Nasir realised his talent after seeing him dance and decided to cast him in Yaadon Ki Baaraat alongside stars such as Dharmendra and Vijay Arora. The movie was written by Salim-Javed.

Notably, The 1973 movie turned out to be his major acting debut. Tariq was only 22 when the movie turned him into an overnight sensation. Looking back at the phase when he became a star, Tariq described it as an “euphoric” experience and credited Nasir Hussain with recognising his potential in a 2021 interview with HT.

As per the latest buzz, The movie gave him several memorable moments, particularly through the songs Yaadon Ki Baaraat, Aap Ke Kamre Mein and Lekar Hum Deewana Dil. Tariq lip-synced, played the guitar and danced in the songs, which went on to become hugely popular. He became the heartthrob of the 1970s and was known as the “rockstar” and “the guitar boy”. Interestingly, his cousin Aamir Khan also appeared in the movie as the younger version of Tariq’s character, Monto.

In further updates, If Yaadon Ki Baaraat introduced Tariq as Bollywood’s new young heartthrob, Hum Kisise Kum Naheen cemented his popularity. The 1977 musical, also directed by Nasir Hussain, became a major success and gave Tariq another strong lead role at a time when his career was gathering momentum. It further established Tariq as one of the promising young stars of the era. However, his journey in Bollywood did not turn out as expected.

On top of that, He went on to play a negative role in the movie Zamaane Ko Dikhana Hai, where he played Kader Khan’s son. The movie also featured stars such as Rishi Kapoor, Padmini Kolhapure and Amjad Khan, but still failed to make a mark and flopped at the ticket-window. After this, Tariq’s career went downhill. He featured in films such as Shaukeen and Pasand Apni Apni with Ashok Kumar, Manzil Manzil with Sunny Deol and Baat Ban Jaye with Sanjeev Kumar, but all of these were supporting roles.

His last movie, Mera Damad, was rolled out in 1995, after which he quit Bollywood. He admitted that taking up a role in Zamaane Ko Dikhana Hai might have been a mistake. At the same time, he opened up that he had signed several films as a leading man, but many of those projects never made it to completion. For an star trying to establish himself, unfinished films meant that the momentum he had built could not always translate into a sustained career.

title: Director Shakeel Noorani arrested in alleged rape case; actor accuses him of drugging her, threatening with video
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Director Shakeel Noorani, 73, who is known for producing and directing films such as Bade Dil Wala (1999) and Joru Ka Ghulam (2000), was arrested by the Malvani Police in the early hours of August 8 before being brought to Mumbai in connection with an alleged rape and sexual assault case filed by a 33-year-old female star.

Adding to this, Director Shakeel Noorani arrested in alleged rape case of star. What is the case? According to a report in Mid-day, the director is accused of calling a woman to his Malvani residence on the pretext of discussing an soon-to-release movie project and sexually assaulting her. He is also accused of administering a sedative and threatening the woman with an alleged video. Police sources told the website that the director was traced to a farmhouse in Medha, Satara district, and arrested.

Meanwhile, The Malvani Police have registered a case under Sections 64(2)(M), 123, 351(2) and 88 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). Police have sought his custody to further investigate the case and ascertain whether the alleged offences took place at other locations. The Borivali holiday court “remanded Noorani in police custody till August 12”.

Notably, The report states that the star first met the director in 2016 at an award show in Lokhandwala. During their interaction at the award show, he allegedly asked her to contact him for work regarding an soon-to-release project.

As per the latest buzz, In the FIR, she alleged that the director gave her a drink, after which she fell unconscious when she later visited his Malvani residence to read a script. She further alleged that Noorani threatened to circulate a video that he had recorded and warned her not to approach the police or inform her family. She accused him of using the video as a tool to threaten her further and sexually assault her repeatedly and on multiple occasions.

In further updates, As per the report, she also alleged that Noorani repeatedly gave her contraceptive pills following the alleged sexual encounters. The report states that the woman returned to Mumbai in 2026 while seeking financial assistance for medical treatment.

On top of that, Shakeel's advocate Vikas Singh Goar has maintained that his client has been falsely implicated. “The allegations made by the star are yet to be established before a court, and the investigation is underway. Noorani is presumed innocent unless proven guilty,” he shared.

title: Exclusive | Ravi Kishan on viral meme fest: Gen Z has accepted me as their own, it's their love and Mahadev's blessing
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ravi Kishan may not have set out to become the internet’s latest obsession, but social media had other plans. The star and Lok Sabha member has lately found himself at the centre of a meme frenzy, with his expressions, dance moves and distinctive dialogue delivery on podcasts and interviews becoming fodder for countless widely shared posts.

Adding to this, Star Ravi Kishan and his widely shared memes From ‘Pehchaan or Paisa? Paisaan! Money follows… my braatheer’ and ‘Hmmmmmm… better do it!’ to ‘Jaldi, the late!’, Kishan’s every move seems to be finding a new audience online.
Meanwhile, We caught up with Kishan, who, in his inimitable style, sums up the phenomenon simply: “I don’t do it… it happens, brother!”
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by HT City (@htcity)

As per the latest buzz, He shares, “Yeh kuch alag hi khel chal raha hai, yeh pagalpan hai! Shravan month is on and when Mahadev showers his blessings, this happens. It has never happened before for anyone – star or politician – in this country. Pagalpan hai! People speak anything to become popular and my maun vrat became even more popular.”

In further updates, For Kishan, perhaps the most surprising part is that none of this was planned. “The best part is that this is happening organically. Even the BJP handle, Delhi Police and Maharashtra Government have made memes. I am personally following it all and dropping a ‘like’ as well,” he says.
On top of that, View this post on Instagram A post shared by DelhiPolice (@delhi.police_official)

The 57-year-old credits Gen Z for it all: “No one has discovered me before. Now, they want to see me more and know me more. Gen Z has accepted me as their own. I really want to thank them and salute their creativity.”

title: Jimmy Shergill reflects on Satluj row, recalls Maachis' success despite similar theme: ‘Politics exists’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Jimmy Shergill says films attempting to portray politically sensitive periods of history often run into trouble as they bring out hidden truths, and things naturally become complicated and political.

Adding to this, Jimmy Shergill reacts to Satluj row, Jimmy Shergill on Satluj row The star responded to a query on why a movie like Satluj , which dealt with a sensitive subject, did not see a rollout while his own debut, Maachis, dealing with a similar theme was appreciated.
Meanwhile, Satluj starring star-singer Diljit Dosanjh rolled out in India last month on streaming service ZEE5 but became unavailable on the platform just two days later in India.

Notably, The movie, based on the life of human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra, was stuck in censorship for over three years and was given over 127 cuts by the Central Board of Movie Certification (CBFC).

As per the latest buzz, "Politics exists, and it will always go on. But it is good when such issues are stirred up because it brings every single aspect out into the open. When you touch upon even a single aspect of sensitive matters, other hidden aspects surface as well. So, that is the politics of it," Shergill told PTI in an interview.

In further updates, On the other side, Maachis, which was directed by Gulzar, was set against the turbulent period of insurgency in Punjab during the 1980s. Also starring Chandrachur Singh, Om Puri, and Tabu, the political thriller explores the personal and political turmoil faced by people caught in violence.

On top of that, Upon the rollout, Maachis received critical acclaim and was a commercial hit too. At the 44th National Movie Awards, the movie won two honours, including Best Popular Movie Providing Wholesome Entertainment and Best Star award for Tabu.
Shergill, who made his acting debut with Maachis, shared he was largely guided by the filmmaker's vision.

title: Characters have lost their distinct identity in Hindi cinema: Actor Akhilendra Mishra
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Lucknow, Veteran star Akhilendra Mishra says the enduring popularity of memorable characters in Hindi cinema and television has faded because today's films are no longer creating distinct personalities on screen, with most roles beginning to resemble one another.

Adding to this, Characters have lost their distinct identity in Hindi cinema: Star Akhilendra Mishra In conversation with PTI during a visit here, the star, known for roles such as Kroor Singh in "Chandrakanta", Mirchi Seth in "Sarfarosh", DSP Bhurelal in "Gangajal", shared strong characterisation, rather than screen time, was what once made supporting roles live on in public memory.
Meanwhile, Mishra also essayed the role of Arjan in the Aamir Khan-starrer Oscar-nominated "Lagaan", which is celebrated 25th anniversary this year.

Notably, "Earlier, people connected with characters. Today, films lack characterisation. Everyone acts in a similar way and speaks in the same tone. In the process, the colour and identity of characters have disappeared. When audiences cannot relate to a character, films eventually suffer," Mishra shared.
As per the latest buzz, Drawing an analogy, he shared audiences respond to diversity in storytelling just as they marvel at a rainbow rather than plain white light.

In further updates, "When you see a rainbow, you call others to look at it because all seven colours are visible. Similarly, stories, performances, music, emotions and presentation need different shades. Today, we are only seeing white light.

On top of that, "They searched for actors who could become those characters. I was chosen for Kroor Singh because of my theatre work. John Matthew Matthan picked me for 'Sarfarosh' after watching one of my plays," he recalled.
The star, however, acknowledged the industry's working culture has become more organised.

title: Guru Randhawa seeks solace at the Golden Temple amid Fine Shyt backlash, turns off comments: ‘No storm can ever shake’

Amid the criticism, Guru appears to have taken a break from the chatter, as he of late shared a photo of himself at the Golden Temple in Amritsar.

Though he did not address the backlash directly, he posted a message in Punjabi talking about faith, strength and continuing to move ahead despite difficult times.

Meanwhile, He wrote in the caption in Punjabi, which roughly translates to, "Whom Waheguru blesses, no storm can ever shake. When Baba Nanak holds someone’s hand, they only keep moving forward." Guru also switched off the comments section on the post.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Raha may be one of Bollywood’s youngest star kids, but according to her grandfather Mahesh Bhatt , she has already become the centre of attention at home. The filmmaker of late opened up about his granddaughter’s lively personality, saying her energy takes over the entire household and predicting that she could one day “outdistance” her famous parents, Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt .

Adding to this, Mahesh Bhatt says Raha will outdistance her parents. Mahesh Bhatt talks about granddaughter Raha Talking about Raha in an interview with Times of India, Mahesh spoke about how her energy captivates everyone and shared, “She'll outdistance Ranbir Kapoor and Alia by miles. She's different. She has a different vibe. When she comes, the whole house becomes hostage to her energy. For those few hours, she becomes the centre of everything.”

Meanwhile, He added that Raha reminds him of a younger Pooja Bhatt and shared, “I of late went with Neetu (Kapoor) to her school for her Grandparents' Day. Soni was in Istanbul. We were walking through a cloud of soap bubbles. I was holding Raha's hand while Neetu was holding the other. It was a beautiful moment. That was something which I remember doing with only Pooja. It brought back memories of walking with Pooja when she was little. Suddenly, time collapsed. She is a vibrant version of Pooja. (Eventually) The same kind of family.”

Notably, Ranbir and Alia tied the knot in an intimate wedding ceremony at their residence in 2022, with only close friends and family in attendance. The same year, the couple welcomed their daughter, Raha. When Raha turned one, Ranbir and Alia introduced her to the world. While some followers felt she was a mini version of her mother, others also noticed a resemblance to her late grandfather, Rishi Kapoor.

As per the latest buzz, Alia and Ranbir have often spoken about how Raha has changed them. In a podcast with Jay Shetty, Alia spoke about Ranbir and Raha’s bond and shared, "When he looks at Raha, there are stars in his eyes. Of course, (that’s true) for any parents. But when I see it, because I’ve known Ranbir before and I know him now, I see the difference. I see the difference in the way he is with people, you know, as a father. He’s just so sort of full. It’s not like he was ever edgy. He always had a very calm demeanour, but there’s a fullness which I experienced first-hand and that I see on a daily basis, and it’s actually really sweet and special to watch their conversations."

title: Piyush Mishra joins Jharkhand students' protest, sings Aarambh Hai Prachand
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Star Piyush Mishra joined the ongoing protests by JPSC-JSSC aspirants in Ranchi, saying he was moved by the "pain and suffering" of the students and wanted to stand by them in their fight.

Adding to this, Piyush Mishra also provided financial aid to the protestors. Piyush Mishra joins student protest in Ranchi The star and singer arrived at the protest site and spoke about his decision to join the students. He shared watching interviews with some of the protesting aspirants was enough to make him come and support their cause.

Meanwhile, While in conversation with the media, the singer-star shared, "I did not come to extend my support for any other reason. I watched interviews with some of the students. I saw the pain and suffering in their eyes, and I saw their tears. That was enough for me."

Notably, Mishra also spoke about his connection with young people and shared he wanted to do whatever was possible to help the protesters. He shared assistance in the form of "food, tarpaulins" and financial help had already been provided.

As per the latest buzz, "I like young people. I sing for you and act for you, so I came here... Apart from this, we have already provided assistance in the form of food, tarpaulins, and whatever financial help we could offer. We are doing whatever is within our capacity," he added.

In further updates, Another video from the protest shows the star singing his song 'Aarambh Hai Prachand' from the 2009 Hindi movie Gulaal. The song was written, composed and sung by Piyush and is known for its revolutionary lyrics, which explore themes of courage, resilience and standing against injustice.

On top of that, Meanwhile, Bollywood singer-composer Ankur R Pathak also joined the protest on Friday and extended his support to JPSC-JSSC aspirants demanding action over alleged irregularities in recruitment examinations.

In conversation with ANI, Ankur shared the students protesting today could go on to become the country's future administrators and leaders. He urged people across the country to come forward and support them, saying their fight was linked to the future of the youth.

title: Avika Gor hospitalised with Dengue after five days of high fever
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Despite having a temperature of 103–104 degrees, the star continued shooting and travelled to Delhi for an ad commitment.

Adding to this, On Friday, Milind shared a video on Instagram in which he opened up that Avika had been admitted the previous night. He also spoke about how she continued to fulfil her professional commitments despite suffering from a high fever.

Meanwhile, He shared, “Avika has been in the hospital since last night. She has had a fever of 103–104 degrees for the past five days. And guess what she did during those five days? She first went to a project where two days of shooting were still pending. She performed so well despite having a 104-degree fever that they managed to wrap up the shoot in just one day. Then she came back and got a two-day break. She spent the entire day in bed, taking medicines, unable to move or even eat properly. But because she had made a commitment, she travelled to Delhi with the same fever and shot an ad. She also got herself tested before that. When she returned to Mumbai, we checked the report and it showed dengue. I told her many times that the producers would understand and that we could postpone it, but she kept saying, ‘Someone will suffer a loss, someone’s time will be wasted, someone’s money will be lost. I don’t want that. I’ll do as much as I can.’”

Notably, Milind also spoke about Avika’s dedication towards her profession and her consideration for other people’s time and resources. “I have never understood where someone gets so much love for their work from. The amount of respect she has for her craft and the value she places on other people’s time and resources, I don’t think many people in this industry do that. Anyway, I request all of you to please keep her in your prayers. I am proud of you, Avika,” he shared.

As per the latest buzz, Avika began her acting career as a child artist with the 2007 television series Ssshhhh… Koi Hai. In 2008, she was cast as Anandi in Balika Vadhu, a role that brought her widespread recognition. She later appeared in shows including Sasural Simar Ka and Laado – Veerpur Ki Mardani.
In further updates, Avika has also worked in Hindi and Telugu films and is currently a contestant on Khatron Ke Khiladi 15. Her last Telugu movie appearance was in Ugly Story .

title: Assam CM thanks Samay Raina for ₹10 lakh flood donation; internet asks him to withdraw FIR against comedian
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

After Bhumi Pednekar and Randeep Hooda headed to Assam to participate in relief efforts in the flood-hit state, comedian Samay Raina has extended help in his own way. The comedian has donated ₹ 10 lakh to the Assam Chief Minister’s Relief Fund to help flood-affected communities in the state.

Adding to this, Samay Raina has done his bit to help those affected by Assam floods. Samay Raina donates ₹ 10 lakh Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma acknowledged Samay's donation on social media and shared that such contributions strengthen relief and rehabilitation efforts following the destructive floods that the state is battling.

Meanwhile, The Assam Chief Minister’s Office on X, along with RTGS (Real Time Gross Settlement), posted a screenshot of the bank transaction made by Samay. The official handle wrote, "HCM Dr @himantabiswa acknowledges the contribution of 10 lakh to the Chief Minister's Relief Fund by Shri Samay Raina."
Notably, The CM also tweeted about it on his own X profile. He wrote, "Thank you for contributing to our relief efforts during this difficult time in Assam, Samay!"

As per the latest buzz, Assam continues to grapple with the impact of the floods. As per PTI, more than 1.55 lakh people remained affected by the Assam floods, with the toll in this year's deluge reaching 98. A total of 1,55,849 people were reeling under the deluge, with Golaghat being the worst-hit district, where 58,750 people were affected, followed by Sivasagar and Jorhat. On Thursday, over 1.68 lakh people across 15 districts were affected.

In further updates, Samay Raina's connection to Assam dates back to 2025, when Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma criticised the content of his show India's Got Latent following the much-publicised row. The Assam Police later also filed an FIR against Raina, YouTuber Ranveer Allahbadia and others over alleged obscenity and vulgar discussions.

On top of that, After the CM thanked Samay for his contribution, many in the comment section asked him to withdraw the FIR against the comedian. A comment read, “Please withdrawal Samay bhai's case sir.” Another comment read, “Please withdraw FIR.”

Randeep Hooda had reached the flood-affected districts of Assam and took part in a flood relief distribution programme organised by an NGO in Sivasagar. He shared a video on Instagram, giving an update on the relief efforts taking place on the ground. He was seen distributing kitchen essentials from a boat to a house and walking through knee-deep water. He wrote in the caption, "Assam is battling devastating floods, leaving countless families in urgent need of support. Every contribution can help provide relief, food, shelter and essential supplies to those affected. Let us come together and help the people of Assam through this crisis. Scan the QR code."

Notably, In fact, Sunny Deol, during the trailer launch of the movie, revealed about hearing first-hand accounts of the Partition from his grandparents, who faced the trauma back then. He shared, “We are from Punjab and during the Partition, my grandfather and grandmother were on the other side. I had heard many incidents from them, which were really very emotional. I heard from them that in case of an untoward incident in any village, the rest of the villagers would come together to hide them and thus protect them from the rioters. Uss waqt mahaul hi aisa tha ke ki kuchh hona nahin chahiye.”

title: Zeenat Aman's son Zahaan calls Tarun Tejpal's conviction for sexual assault ‘unjust’, says ‘there's more to the story’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Journalist and former Tehelka editor Tarun Tejpal was convicted on August 6, 2026, by the Goa Bench of the Bombay High Court in a 2013 sexual assault case and sentenced to 10 years of rigorous imprisonment. After the judgment, veteran star Zeenat Aman's son Zahaan Khan showed support for Tarun. The Bombay High Court's verdict overturned Tejpal's 2021 acquittal by a Goa trial court.

Adding to this, Zeenat Aman's son Zahaan Khan supports Tarun Tejpal after his conviction. Zeenat Aman's son supports Tarun Tejpal Zahaan Khan took to his Instagram Stories and called Tarun Tejpal's conviction 'unjust'. He wrote, "We're living in a time when our ability to think critically and exercise independent judgment is increasingly being compromised. We are rewarded for displaying certainty over nuance, reaction over reflection, and emotion over evidence. Once someone is labelled, it becomes easier to take the shortcut of ending the conversation. Don't let other people think for you."

Meanwhile, He added, "All this is to say that there is more nuance to the story of Tarun Tejpal's recent and, in my view, unjust conviction. Leaving a comment is a form of investment. If you're truly invested, start with nuance."

Notably, Zahaan Khan is the younger son of veteran Bollywood star Zeenat Aman and her late husband, star-producer Mazhar Khan. He is a freelance composer and a culinary arts graduate. Zahaan is the partner of Cara Tejpal, daughter of Tarun Tejpal and Geetan Batra. She is an environmentalist and writer. Tarun's other daughter, Tiya Tejpal, is married to star Arjun Mathur.

As per the latest buzz, In 2013, a former female colleague accused Tejpal of sexually assaulting her during Tehelka's annual event in Goa. Tejpal denied the allegations but stepped down as Tehelka's editor-in-chief after the accusations surfaced. Goa Police arrested him in November 2013, and he was subsequently charged with rape, sexual harassment and wrongful confinement, among other offences.

In further updates, In May 2021, a Goa trial court acquitted Tejpal of all charges, citing inconsistencies and gaps in the prosecution's case. The Goa government subsequently challenged the acquittal in the Bombay High Court.

On top of that, On Thursday, the Goa Bench of the Bombay High Court convicted Tejpal under sections of Indian law pertaining to rape and sexual assault. He was sentenced to 10 years in prison. The court also ordered him to pay fines amounting to more than ₹ 5 lakh.

title: When sensitive issues are stirred up, it brings everything into open: Jimmy Shergill on ‘Satluj’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mumbai, Star Jimmy Shergill says films attempting to portray politically sensitive periods of history often run into trouble as they bring out hidden truths, and things naturally become complicated and political.

Adding to this, When sensitive issues are stirred up, it brings everything into open: Jimmy Shergill on ‘Satluj’ The star responded to a query on why a movie like "Satluj", which dealt with a sensitive subject, did not see a rollout while his own debut, "Maachis", dealing with a similar theme was appreciated.
Meanwhile, "Satluj", starring star-singer Diljit Dosanjh rolled out in India last month on streaming service ZEE5 but became unavailable on the platform just two days later in India.

Notably, The movie, based on the life of human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra, was stuck in censorship for over three years and was given over 127 cuts by the Central Board of Movie Certification .

As per the latest buzz, "Politics exists, and it will always go on. But it is good when such issues are stirred up because it brings every single aspect out into the open. When you touch upon even a single aspect of sensitive matters, other hidden aspects surface as well. So, that is the politics of it," Shergill told PTI in an interview.

In further updates, On the other side, "Maachis", which was directed by Gulzar, was set against the turbulent period of insurgency in Punjab during the 1980s. Also starring Chandrachur Singh, Om Puri, and Tabu, the political thriller explores the personal and political turmoil faced by people caught in violence.

On top of that, Upon the rollout, "Maachis" received critical acclaim and was a commercial hit too. At the 44th National Movie Awards, the movie won two honours, including Best Popular Movie Providing Wholesome Entertainment and Best Star award for Tabu.
Shergill, who made his acting debut with "Maachis", shared he was largely guided by the filmmaker's vision.

title: ‘Shah Rukh Khan felt it was like a temple': Chef Vikas Khanna recalls SRK's visit to his New York restaurant Bungalow
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Several celebrities, including Ranveer Singh, Deepika Padukone , Shah Rukh Khan and others, have visited his restaurant. Of late, during a chat with Shekhar Suman on his show Shekhar Tonite, Vikas recalled Shah Rukh’s reaction to Bungalow and opened up that the star saw it as much more than just a restaurant.

Adding to this, Vikas Khanna recalls Shah Rukh Khan's visit to his restaurant. What Shah Rukh Khan shared about Vikas Khanna's Bungalow Recalling SRK's words, Vikas shared, “There are so many restaurants in the world, but Shah Rukh Khan shared, ‘Every restaurant I’ve visited until today has felt like a shop to me, just a transaction. But when I came here, it felt like I had entered someone’s temple. It felt as though you were trying to represent our rich culture, our parents, our ancestors. That’s an incredibly difficult thing to do.’” Vikas shared that SRK's words stayed with him.

Meanwhile, In 2024, Vikas posted on Instagram to share a deeply personal account of Shah Rukh Khan’s visit to Bungalow. Recalling the moment, the chef wrote that his life revolves around three people: his mother, Chef Sanjeev Kapoor and SRK. Khanna then recalled how SRK asked him to sit with him during his visit to Bungalow. The two spoke about Khanna’s childhood memories of watching Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge. “When SRK visited Bungalow & asked me to sit with him. As we spoke about me going to the cinema every day to watch DDLJ with my sister, and every movie of his. He became my hero for who he is. His voice. His patience. His confidence. His compassion. His friendship.”

Notably, He added, "To hold back my tears, I looked up the glass ceiling & saw the clear crescent of the moon watching over me. People who lose the ones they loved the most always find signs of them watching over us. Today is dedicated to you, Sir. You holding my hand and saying, ‘Bungalow represents us. Our parents. Our ancestors. Our India’. This is everything to a scared-paranoid-failed child from Amritsar.”

title: Aryabhatt Ka Zero review: Ravi Kishan, Himansh Kohli's slice of life film is a two-hour-long trip to nowhere
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

We have had films that motivate you to study harder, work harder, or simply be a better person. And then there are films like Aryabhatt Ka Zero, which are as aimless as their lead character. On my personal list of ‘Films That Have No Reason To Exist’, this one surely ranks somewhere.

Adding to this, Aryabhatt Ka Zero review: Himansh Kohli and Ravi Kishan lead the slice of life movie. The plot Directed by Kamal Chandra, the movie revolves around Baggu (Himansh Kohli), a good-for-nothing guy who has been bad at studies. His girlfriend, Rinku (Sonnalli Seygall), is married off to an SDM (Gopal Dutt). Baggu, in a fit of rage, decides to take the UPSC exam to become a DM. At this point, as a viewer, you are probably thinking the rest of the movie is about how he pulls it off. No.

Meanwhile, What begins as a movie about fulfilling one’s duty towards one’s parents and finding motivation soon derails. In a bid to help his struggling family after a personal crisis, Baggu takes up the first job that comes his way, finally beginning to take life seriously. But by the time the climax arrives, the story suddenly starts preaching that success in life has little to do with hard work. It happens so abruptly that the viewer barely gets time to process what just happened. Talk about an anti-climactic twist.

Notably, What the two-hour-long movie gets right is its setting. Shot entirely across Delhi and the hills, cinematographer Yogesh Jani does a good job of capturing both. The screenplay, however, leaves plenty of room for improvement. There are stretches where the story moves forward, but the viewer feels nothing. It is progression for the sake of progression.

As per the latest buzz, What also doesn’t help is Himansh Kohli, who is literally present in almost every frame, delivering a rather hit-and-miss performance. The character needed more spunk, but Kohli often ends up bringing down the movie’s energy quotient instead. A movie of this nature ought to have been far more lively. While he is effective in the emotional scenes, there is little spark in his act otherwise.

In further updates, Sonnalli Seygall pitches in with a decent performance, and her chemistry with Himansh also works. Ravi Kishan as Chhanu bhaiya could have done with more scenes featuring him. Shilpa Shinde as Simmi, Baggu's sister, plays her role well. Neeraj Sood as Aryabhatt, Baggu's father, stands out, playing his part very well, and actually lending the movie some of its more watchable scenes. The music by Manan Bhardwaj is not too impressive.

On top of that, Overall, Aryabhatt Ka Zero is undone by its confused writing. There is nothing wrong with making a movie about an ordinary, directionless young man trying to turn his life around. In fact, Baggu’s journey could have made for an affecting watch if the movie had invested more in his transformation and given his choices some weight. Instead, the narrative keeps taking detours, only to arrive at a conclusion that feels less like a culmination and more like a different movie suddenly taking over. There are a few performances and moments that keep you engaged, but they are not enough to rescue a screenplay that seems unsure. By the end, Aryabhatt Ka Zero leaves you with neither inspiration nor entertainment, which is quite a feat for a movie that tries to offer both.

title: Sayeed Quadri admits pressure while recreating Tera Mera Rishta and To Phir Aao for Awarapan 2: 'Sharminda na hona pade'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The cult classic Awarapan is returning with a sequel, Awarapan 2, set to rollout in theatres this month. The movie brings back Emraan Hashmi in his now-iconic role as Shivam Pandit, a hitman with a conscience. Among other things, connecting the sequel to the first part are two songs: To Phir Aao and Tera Mera Rishta. Both songs, part of the Awarapan soundtrack, became chartbusters in 2007. Now, they are being recreated by their original lyricist, Saeed Quadri and composed by Mithoon . Talking about the responsibility of recreating such iconic tracks, Saeed Quadri talks of pressures, validation, and more. Excerpts:

Adding to this, Emraan Hashmi in a still from Awarapan 2. HT: When we return to an album that has been so highly acclaimed, how do you bring freshness to it while retaining its essence and soul, so that it feels like Awarapan yet is also new? Sayeed Quadri: Jo pehli baar jo maine likha tha, uski khushboo mere andar kahin na kahin hamesha baaki rahegi. [The essence of what I wrote originally will always remain within me somewhere]. And here, I didn't have to redo someone else's song. I had to recreate my own song with new words. So, you just add creative elements to the essence in you, and the work starts flowing.

Meanwhile, Sayeed Quadri: No hesitation. I never recreate what others create. You must have seen in my nearly 40-45 years of career. But for the first time, I am working on a song I wrote. That's why I did it. And besides, this movie is actually very close to me, very connected to my life. This character of Shivam Pandit, played by Emraan Hashmi, is close to me. Uske andar jo bechaini hai khaalipan hai hai, wo kahin na kahin hum hum logon ke andar bhi rehta hai struggle ke time. (The restlessness and emptiness within him remain within us too, somewhere during the time of struggle).

Notably, Sayeed Quadri: Haan ye zaroor mehsoos hua ki pehle gaanon ko bahut pyar mila hai to kam se kam iss baar sunne walon ke saamne sharminda nahi hona pade. (I definitely felt that since our previous songs received a lot of love, we shouldn't have to be embarrassed in front of our listeners this time). When you become a brand, people expect that whatever work you put out will be better. Then it inspires you to work from the heart and with honesty. Baaki bas yahi chaah hai ki jo mera sunne wala hai jo mujhe pyar karta hai jo mera chahne wala hai, uske chehre pe shikan nahi aani chahiye ki bhai kya likha hai (I only want that my listener and my well-wisher shouldn’t be thinking what he has written).

As per the latest buzz, Sayeed Quadri: We were disappointed at that time. We had the satisfaction that we all worked together very honestly. So we knew that one day our hard work would definitely bear fruit. And slowly people started falling in love with the movie, with Emraan’s character, and the songs. Kuch cheezein kai baar waqt leti hain, thoda sa hai. Par ye nahi kahoonga ki thoda mann udaas nahi tha. (Some things take time. But I won't say that the heart wasn’t a little sad).

In further updates, Presented by Mukesh Bhatt and Vishesh Films, Awarapan 2 is produced by Vishesh Bhatt, directed by Nitin Kakkar and written by Bilal Siddiqui. Apart from Emraan, it also stars Disha Patani, Shabana Azmi, and Suvinder Vicky. The movie is scheduled to rollout in cinemas worldwide on August 14.

title: Mumbai Police constable guarding Salman Khan's residence dies of suspected heart attack: Report
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A 41-year-old Mumbai Police constable deployed outside Bollywood star Salman Khan's residence has as per reports passed away. The constable, identified as Ganesh Rayate, was on guard duty outside the star's Galaxy Apartments when he as per reports passed away after suffering a suspected heart attack on Friday evening.

Adding to this, Police constable Ganesh Rayate was assigned to guard Salman Khan's residence. (PTI) Police constable guarding Salman's home dies According to a report in The Free Press Journal, the constable was posted with LA-4 of the Mumbai Police. He complained of uneasiness at around 6 pm to other police personnel, following which they immediately rushed him to Bhabha Hospital for treatment. However, he was declared dead on arrival. According to police officials, Rayate is suspected to have suffered a heart attack while on duty. However, his body has been sent for a post-mortem examination, and the exact cause of death will be verified after the medical report.

Meanwhile, The incident comes amid heightened security for Salman Khan. The increase in security came after Salman got repeated threats allegedly made by the Lawrence Bishnoi gang, which also claimed responsibility for Siddique's murder, in connection with the long-running Black Buck case dating back to the 1990s.

Notably, Last year, Salman spoke to the media about the heightened security. He shared, “God, Allah — it is all in His hands. One lives exactly as long as is ordained; that is all there is to it. Sometimes, having to move around with so many people becomes a problem.”

title: Anupam Kher on 40 years of Karma: Saaransh established me as an actor, Karma made me a commercial star
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Anupam Kher and late Dilip Kumar in Karma. Starring Dilip Kumar in the leading role along with actors Anil Kapoor , Jackie Shroff and Naseeruddin Shah, the 1986 actioner directed by Subhash Ghai was a big hit commercially. Anupam, in a negative role as Doctor Dang, had garnered praise.

Adding to this, He shared a video on Instagram, and wrote in the caption, “40 YEARS OF KARMA! 40 years ago, KARMA happened! And what a smash hit it was! What a movie! What memories! What a turning point in my life! #Saaransh had established me as an star. But Subhash Ghai Sahab’s KARMA made me a commercial star. Suddenly, I was part of that larger-than-life world of mainstream Hindi cinema. And I was loving every moment of it!”

Meanwhile, He went on to cherish the fact that Karma gave him a chance to work with the late legend Dilip Kumar, “But the greatest gift Karma gave me was the privilege of working with the one and only Dilip Kumar Saab. To share the screen with him, to watch him perform from such close quarters, to learn from his silences, his pauses, his presence — that was my real award. Thank you, Subhash Ghai Sahab, for trusting me with Dr. Dang and for giving me an opportunity that changed the course of my career. “इस थप्पड़ की गूँज सुनी तुमने, डॉ. डैंग?” Some films give you success. Some give you memories. KARMA gave me both…. for a lifetime! Happy 40 years to the entire team of KARMA! Jai Ho!”
Notably, Meanwhile, on the professional front right now, Anupam has wrapped his work on the movie Khosla Ka Ghosla 2, a sequel to the 2006 original which has gained cult status by now.

title: BREAKING: Ramayana’s UNIQUE release strategy REVEALED; Namit Malhotra confirms international release on November 6; India to witness the epic on Diwali, November 8
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

In an interview with NDTV, Namit Malhotra opened up that since Diwali falls on Sunday, November 8, audiences in India will get to watch Ramayana on the big screen on the festival day itself. Meanwhile, the movie will rollout overseas two days earlier, on Friday, November 6.

Adding to this, When asked about the movie’s rollout date, Namit Malhotra shared in the NDTV interview, “It’ll rollout in India on Diwali.” When specifically asked if that meant Ramayana would arrive in Indian theatres on November 8, he replied in the affirmative.

Meanwhile, The reporter then pointed out that the of late rolled out English version of the Ramayana trailer mentions November 6 as the rollout date. Explaining the difference, Namit Malhotra shared, “So, we are releasing internationally (on November 6). The international distribution works from a Friday standpoint. So, that is on the 6th of November. But India currently we are targeting a rollout on Diwali.”

Notably, While Dharma Productions will distribute Ramayana in India, Sony Pictures has picked up the overseas distribution rights. Last week, Bollywood Hungama broke the news that T-Series has bagged the music rights to both parts of Ramayana for Rs. 75 crores in an advance deal.

As per the latest buzz, Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. It is directed by Nitesh Tiwari of Dangal (2016) fame and produced by Namit Malhotra. The music is composed by A R Rahman and Hans Zimmer. It's a two-part saga with the first part releasing on Diwali 2026. As for the second part, it'll arrive on the big screen on Diwali 2027.

title: Sanjeeda Shaikh laughs at doing action in Dhamaal 4 while the men did comedy: 'Ajay Devgn set pe hain aur...'| Interview
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Dhamaal 4 was a chaotic return to the franchise started by Indra Kumar almost two decades ago. The comedy actioner saw the return of franchise favourites Ajay Devgn , Riteish Deshmukh, Arshad Warsi, and Jaaved Jaaferi, while also introducing new faces to the series. Among them was star Sanjeeda Shaikh , who found herself doing a bit of both action and comedy in the movie. In an exclusive chat with Hindustan Times, Sanjeeda looks back on how she landed the role and her filming experience.

Adding to this, Sanjeeda Sheikh with Arshad Warsi and Jaaved Jaaferi in Dhamaal 4. Sanjeeda on ‘serious star’ tag Prior to Dhamaal 4, Sanjeeda had not dabbled in comedy. Her previous show before this was Sanjay Leela Bhansali’s intense period drama Heeramandi. The star says the tag of ‘serious star’ followed her after this. “Dhamaal 4 happened to me because Indra sir (director Indra Kumar) called me, and he met me after watching Heeramandi. And unka pehla sawal tha ki ‘Aap toh bahut serious star hain (You are a very serious star),’ because Heeramandi was very serious.” Sanjeeda shared she told the filmmaker to give her a chance to show how funny she is. “I sat with him, and I think he heard me laughing—and I laugh like a man—so he shared, ‘Okay, this is fine.” And meri casting ho gayi (My casting was done,” she adds with a laugh.
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Sanjeeda Shaikh (@iamsanjeeda)

Notably, Dhamaal 4 saw her share the screen with comedy veterans. The star felt she had to up her game and not stick out. “You are working and sharing the screen with Ajay sir, Arshad, Riteish; those people whose comic timing is such that they elevate the scene even without speaking. So, you have to up your game. My focus was on ensuring my character would not be lost, because this is an established franchise with beloved characters. I should not look out of place,” says Sanjeeda.

As per the latest buzz, In Dhamaal 4, Sanjeeda’s character does as much action as she does comedy. In fact, in many scenes alongside other veteran action stars, it was Sanjeeda’s character in the thick of things. “In all my scenes, if you've seen, there is action involved,” says the star, “Toh mujhe actually ullu banaya gaya, mujhe bola gaya tha ki comedy karni hai lekin mujhe action karwaya gaya. (I was actually fooled; I was told I had to do comedy, but they made me do action).”

In further updates, Sanjeeda says it became a joke on set that she was doing action scenes while Ajay Devgn, a veteran action star, was on set for the comedy bits. “Main sach se boloongi. Ajay Devgn set pe hain aur mujhse saare action sequences karwaye ja rahe hain (Ajay Devgn is on set, and I am doing all the action scenes). It had just become a joke on set.”

On top of that, Dhamaal 4 also starred Ravi Kishan, Sanjay Mishra, Upendra Limaye, Anjali Anand, and Esha Gupta. The movie opened to largely negative reviews but was lapped up by audiences. It has collected over ₹ 200 crore rupees worldwide, emerging as a box-office success.

title: Ramayana to hit the screens in India two days after global release? Producer Namit Malhotra drops bombshell
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The English trailer of Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana was rolled out earlier this week, days after the Indian-language trailers were rolled out. The English-dubbed trailer, for the first time, revealed the movie's exact rollout date: 6 November. Till now, the makers had shared the movie would rollout on Diwali, but had not given an exact date. However, producer Namit Malhotra has now hinted that the movie may have a staggered rollout worldwide, with the Ranbir Kapoor and Yash-starrer hitting the screens in India two days after its global rollout.

Adding to this, Ranbir Kapoor plays Lord Rama in the movie adaptation of Ramayana. Ramayana rollout date, explained Namit Malhotra spoke to NDTV on the sidelines of the inauguration of his Prime Focus Studio - Phase 1 at Dadasaheb Phalke Chitranagari in Mumbai, where he reaffirmed, “It (Ramayana) will rollout in India on Diwali.” Diwali falls on November 8 this year, two days after the movie's scheduled global rollout. When asked about the confusion between the two dates, Namit added, “We are releasing internationally (on November 6) because the international distribution works from a Friday standpoint, which is the 6th of November. But (in) India, currently, we are targeting the Diwali rollout.”

Meanwhile, The Ramayana trailer has generated significant buzz online, with reactions coming from far and wide. Talking about it, Namit told ANI, “The trailer was rolled out last week, and I think it crossed over a billion views in five days, which is a great moment for India. I really appreciate all the love we've got from people all over the world. The aspiration is to now take it to the world as we are with our partnership with Sony Pictures. We are hoping to make sure that Ramayana now releases globally as a big universal movie.”

Notably, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari , Ramayana is a two-part adaptation of Valmiki’s epic. The movie stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Yash as Ravana, and Sai Pallavi as Sita, along with a large ensemble cast including Ravie Dubey, Sunny Deol, Arun Govil, Lara Dutta, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, and Kunal Kapoor, among others. Part One will rollout in November this year, while Part Two is scheduled for rollout next year, ahead of Diwali.

title: Yash Raj Films to enter horror genre with Varun Dhawan-starrer, Rocket Boys' Abhay Pannu to direct YRF's first horror
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

As the horror genre takes off in Indian cinema, Yash Raj Films , one of the biggest and oldest production houses in India, is as per reports making a foray into it as well. According to sources, the movie stars Varun Dhawan , who has previously dabbled in horror with the Maddock horror-comedy, Bhediya.

Adding to this, Varun Dhawan will headline Yash Raj Films' first horror movie. About Yash Raj Films' first horror movie A source close to the project says, “Varun has come on board as the lead for YRF’s first horror movie. Yash Raj Films (YRF) is entering the horror genre for the first time.” This is the star's first collaboration with YRF since the 2018 slice-of-life drama Sui Dhaaga, which also starred Anushka Sharma.

Meanwhile, The movie is being backed by YRF CEO Akshaye Widhani, who produced the production house's biggest recent success - Saiyaara. Directing the project will be Abhay Pannu, best known for SonyLIV's acclaimed web series Rocket Boys. Pannu has also written the screenplay. The project is scheduled to go on floors later this year. The movie marks Abhay Pannu's theatrical directorial debut after earning acclaim for Rocket Boys.

Notably, “YRF have made films across almost every genre except horror. Come 2027, and the banner will finally step into this genre,” the source adds, indicating that the movie is targeting a 2027 rollout. Further details, including the movie's title and the rest of the star cast, have not yet been revealed.

After Aditya Chopra, Yash's son, joined the company, YRF pivoted toward romance, producing blockbusters like Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge, Dil To Pagal Hai, and Mohabbatein. With Dhoom in 2004, Yash Raj debuted in the action genre, a move they carried forward with their successful YRF Spy Universe, a franchise of interconnected spy thrillers that grossed over ₹ 3000 crore rupees worldwide.

title: ‘Will carry forward his legacy’: Pradeep Rawat's son breaks down in emotional tribute to Ghajini actor
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

On Thursday, the family, friends, and Bollywood colleagues of star Pradeep Rawat gathered for a prayer meet in Mumbai to remember the star, who died earlier this week at 74 after a rapid battle with blood cancer. At the prayer meet, the star's son, Vikramaditya, broke down as he paid an emotional tribute to his father.

Adding to this, Pradeep Rawat's son Vikramaditya paid the star an emotional tribute. Pradeep Rawat's son pays tribute On Thursday, after the prayer meet, Vikramaditya Singh Rawat spoke to news agency ANI, talking about his father's memories and legacy. “No matter how many words I speak about my father, they will always be less. He was a man of honour and respect. No matter how many times I pray to God, or if God asks me what kind of father I want, I will always take his name,” he shared.

Meanwhile, Vikramaditya shared he wants to carry forward his father's legacy, just as his father wanted. “He believed, and I believe too, that one day I will make his name proud. I will carry forward his legacy. I want to follow his legacy, and I want to make it even bigger,” he added.

Notably, Pradeep Rawat, best known for his titular role as the villain in Ghajini, also appeared in blockbusters like Lagaan. He worked extensively in Telugu and Tamil cinema, in addition to Hindi films, over a career that spanned four decades.

As per the latest buzz, At the prayer meet, several actors who worked with Pradeep Rawat over the years shared their memories with the late star. Raghubir Yadav called the loss ‘a big one’ for the industry. “There is a lot of pain, and the movie industry has lost a very big star, a very intelligent star and a truly talented performer. But he will always live in everyone's memories. He will always be remembered,” he added.

In further updates, Mukesh Rishi, who worked with Pradeep Rawat in a number of films, looked back on their long association, which began with Sarfarosh over 26 years ago. “The journey of both of us started with Sarfarosh, where we first met and got to know each other. Later, when I moved to the South, Pradeep also came there. We worked on several films together and got the opportunity to spend a lot of time with each other,” shared the star.

On top of that, Pradeep Rawat is survived by his wife, Kalyani Rawat, and son Vikramaditya Rawat. The star was widely known for his performances in Hindi, Telugu and Tamil films, with memorable roles in Sarfarosh, Lagaan, Sye, Naayak, Ghajini and most of late Chhaava, where he played Yesaji Kank.

Abhimanyu Mathur is Deputy Editor, Entertainment at Hindustan Times. With almost 15 years of experience in writing about everything from films and TV shows to cricket matches and elections, he inhales and exhales pop culture and news. Currently, he watches movies and TV shows and talks to celebrities for a living, while occasionally writing about them as well. A journalism graduate of Delhi College of Arts and Commerce, Delhi University, Abhimanyu began his career with Hindustan Times at the age of 20, swapping classrooms for newsrooms at an early age. He began his journey in the early days of digital journalism, later switching to the madness of print journalism. Work has led him to far off places like Japan and Jordan, as well as to the interiors of Haryana and the Indo-Pak border. He dabbled in city reporting in places like Meerut, Gurgaon, and Delhi, covered the Olympics and Cricket World Cups, before finding his calling in entertainment and lifestyle during the pandemic. A Rotten Tomatoes Certified Movie Critic, he is equally at home covering stories on ground as he is interviewing celebrities and studios, and sometimes prefers to shepherd teams in delivering traffic through the day. title: Rakesh Roshan says he used to hide his pain from daughter Sunaina during her health scare: ‘I used to pray silently’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

It is a parent's worst nightmare to see their child go through a health scare. The same was with veteran filmmaker Rakesh Roshan , who saw his daughter, Sunaina Roshan, deal with multiple health battles all by herself. The author, wellness advocate, and sister of star Hrithik Roshan - has long been open about her health journey, from overcoming a rare form of cancer - cervical lymphoma - and reversing grade 3 fatty liver disease to rebuilding her life through mindful eating and sustainable habits. In recent years, her Instagram has become a space for sharing reflections on nutrition, self-growth, and everyday wellness.

Adding to this, Rakesh Roshan has spoken about the grief of seeing his daughter battle several health scares. What Rakesh shared In her latest Instagram post, she had a heartfelt conversation with her father. In her Instagram series Dad & I Unfiltered, Sunaina shared that it is the first time that she is asking him about what he felt as a father when her “health was at its worst.” In response, he shared, “It's not been once, it has been many times. I used to pray silently. I did have tears in my eyes sometimes, but then I had a different front when I used to come to you to meet you. I used to be smiling always and giving you courage.”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Sunaina Roshan (@roshansunaina)

Notably, Sunaina replied, “I think I have got that strong mindset from you, how to fight everything. And I think I did the same thing when you had cancer. I was very courageous, smiling in front of you. But in my room, I used to sob and sob.”

As per the latest buzz, “I remember there were days, I would actually go to the mirror, start laughing by myself and in that way come and face you. I think I never told you this before. It's the first time I'm telling you that,” she added.

In further updates, Rakesh added that he believes that staying positive during such times can help the patient and family. He shared that instead of showing fear or sadness in front of them, it is better to smile, stay strong and give them confidence.
On top of that, "Looking back, I realise so much of my resilience came from watching my parents face life’s toughest moments with faith, positivity and unconditional love.
To every parent who has smiled through their own fears just to make their child feel stronger… this one’s for you," Sunaina wrote in the caption.

title: Vishal Bhardwaj wants to adapt the Tarun Tejpal case into a “Rashomon”-style film: “It's a very important case for society”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Speaking about the project, Bhardwaj shared the case's contrasting court judgments and its many lesser-known details make it a compelling subject for a movie. He also emphasised that his approach would remain balanced and rooted in multiple perspectives rather than predetermined conclusions.

Adding to this, In an interview with Variety, Bhardwaj shared, "The contradiction between the two judgments makes it a perfect case for a 'Rashomon'-style narrative. There are a lot of facts and incidents in this case that nobody knows about, and people will be amused and surprised to discover them on screen."

Meanwhile, The director revealed, "As they say, the devil lies in the detail. How do you expect people to go through the tiring, dry legal language of a 500-plus-page court judgment? I have gone through the minutest details. I have read the judgment many times and am still grappling with it. It's a very important case for society."

Notably, Bhardwaj clarified that he does not intend to make a movie that begins with a fixed point of view. Instead, he wants to present the story through different perspectives. "It's too early for me to make up my mind on what the movie is about."
As per the latest buzz, He added, "I'm very clear that the approach must be that of a dispassionate observer, like a true movie journalist, if I may say so."

In further updates, Explaining his storytelling philosophy, Bhardwaj shared, "No story is complete without all the different points of view, especially in a 'Rashomon' structure, because half a glass of water is also half empty at the same time. The only difference is perspective."

On top of that, Speaking about casting, Bhardwaj shared he would prefer an star who is unfamiliar with the case so the performance remains free of preconceived ideas: "I want the star to be unaware of the crime, if possible, and to set the judgments aside. I would love for him to approach it as fiction."
The filmmaker also opened up that the project is being produced in association with a major Bollywood studio, although he has not disclosed the name of the production house.

title: Vishal Bhardwaj to make Rashomon-style film on Tarun Tejpal after conviction in 2013 sexual assault case
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The Bombay High Court on Thursday convicted Ex-Tehelka editor Tarun Tejpal in the rape and sexual assault case of a junior colleague at a five-star hotel in Goa in 2013. This controversial case seems to have inspired filmmaker Vishal Bhardwaj to make a movie about it. As per the latest update from Variety, the National Award-winning filmmaker is developing a movie based on the Tarun Tejpal rape case.

Adding to this, Vishal Bhardwaj will make his next case on Tarun Tejpal's conviction. Vishal Bhardwaj sets movie on Tarun Tejpal case The report added that Vishal has read the Goa trial court’s 527-page judgment multiple times and described the divergence between the two rulings as the creative catalyst for his movie. He was also in Goa for the case hearing.

Meanwhile, “The contradiction between the two judgments makes it a perfect case for a ‘Rashomon’-style narrative. There are a lot of facts and incidents in this case that nobody knows about, and people will be amused and surprised to discover them on screen… As they say, the devil lies in the detail. How do you expect people to go through the tiring, dry legal language of a 500-plus-page court judgment? I have gone through the minutest details. I have read the judgment many times and am still grappling with it. It’s a very important case for society,” he added.

Notably, Vishal added why the structure of the movie is important. “No story is complete without all the different points of view, especially in a Rashomon structure, because half a glass of water is also half empty at the same time – the only difference is perspective… I want the star to be unaware of the crime, if possible, and to set the judgments aside. I would love for him to approach it as fiction,” he added.

As per the latest buzz, The Rashomon effect is a narrative storytelling technique in which the same event is described in contradictory ways by multiple characters or witnesses. The name originated with Akira Kurosawa's 1950 movie Rashomon, a legendary movie that first established the trick.
In further updates, Vishal is the director behind Shakespeare adaptations Maqbool, Omkara and Haider. He also directed Makdee, 7 Khoon Maaf, Kaminey and his most recent, O Romeo .

On top of that, The court sentenced Tarun Tejpal to 10 years of rigorous imprisonment and fined him ₹ 5 lakhs for charges under IPC section 376, one year of rigorous imprisonment and a fine of ₹ 10,000 for charges under section 354 (A), and three years of rigorous imprisonment for charges under section 254 (B).

Justices Neela Gokhale and Amit Jamsandekar of the Bombay High Court at Goa overturned Tejpal's acquittal in the case granted to him by sessions judge Kshama Joshi in 2021. "We set aside the trial court order of acquittal. The respondent (Tejpal) stands convicted," the HC bench shared.

title: Honey Trehan reveals gullaks kept in Gurudwaras to help recover Satluj's financial losses: ‘We cannot accept any money’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Honey Trehan’s Jaswant Singh Khalra biopic, Satluj, previously titled Panjab ‘95, had a long journey before it was dropped on Zee5 and was taken down within hours. The Diljit Dosanjh -starrer was not cleared by the Central Board of Movie Certification (CBFC) as the makers did not comply with cuts and missed a theatrical rollout. The filmmaker now reveals that people have tried to raise funds to recoup the movie’s financial losses.

Adding to this, Diljit Dosanjh played Jaswant Singh Khalra in Honey Trehan's Satluj. Honey Trehan reveals gullaks kept in Gurudrawas for Satluj On Friday, Honey rolled out a long note on his Instagram addressing the love Satluj received a month ago when it was rolled out on Zee5 on July 3, but was taken down by July 5. He shared that the movie was an opportunity to honour Jaswant Singh Khalra’s life. “Since then, we have been getting several messages, calls, Instagram DMs and tweets from people trying to reach out to us, the Khalra family and Diljit bhaji, to extend their support and help us with money to recover our losses,” added the filmmaker.

Meanwhile, “We even got to know there are gullaks kept in Gurudwaras where well-wishers are trying to help my producers to recover the losses of 'Satluj: This is happening in India as well as abroad. We thank you deeply for this gesture,” further read a portion of his note, adding, “It is truly special and we respect your emotions. Having shared that, your love and support is more than enough, and with all due respect we cannot accept any money, gifts or donations for our movie.”
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Honey Trehan (@honeytrehan)

As per the latest buzz, Honey shared that he and his producers, RSVP, have accepted that Satluj will have a legacy despite the financial losses. He also asked the audience to consider the movie as their service to the truth, to human rights, and to Khalra’s memory. “It is a small attempt at sharing the collective grief of our loved ones and for the ones who we lost in the darkness irrespective of their caste, religion or social status,” he wrote.

In further updates, “We feel blessed to be a part of this service. We as a team respectfully want to make sure and put it on record that any money collected by anyone in the name of the movie or in the name of any service or donation has nothing to do with team 'Satluj’. Let's help each other with kindness and courage and love so we all can come together to 'challenge the darkness ' when it matters,” wrote the filmmaker at the end of the note.
On top of that, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Rohit Chaturvedi (@rohitrchaturvedi)

When Satl uj was removed from Zee5 in 48 hours, an I&B Ministry official told ANI, “ Satluj did not have the required certification for a theatrical rollout. Instead of complying with the certification process, the makers changed the movie's title and rolled out it on an OTT platform.” After its removal, many people illegally downloaded the movie and held public screenings to ensure it was seen.

title: After calling Gen Z ‘generation gutter’, Kangana Ranaut takes U-turn and now says they are strength of our country
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star and BJP MP Kangana Ranaut grabbed headlines a few days ago for her comments on the Gen Z and the student protests that took place at Jantar Mantar. She labeled certain young protesters and women as "Generation Gutter," accusing them of adopting westernized mindsets. On Friday, Kangana pivoted to praise the Gen Z as India's biggest strength and ambassadors of the country's culture and identity.

Adding to this, Bharatiya Janata Party MP Kangana Ranaut during the Monsoon Session amid rain, in New Delhi. (ANI Photo/Rahul Singh) (Rahul Singh) Kangana's new comments on Gen Z In conversation with news agency PTI, she shared, “Gen Z is the strength of our country and, in a way, a great asset to our nation. We are very happy that our young people are increasingly emerging as ambassadors of our culture and its identity.”

Meanwhile, "We have also had the opportunity to listen to Mohan Bhagwat ji, whom we hold in the highest regard, and benefit from his wisdom and experience. It is a matter of great happiness that the country's youth are connecting with us and embracing our cultural identity," the BJP MP from Mandi in Himachal Pradesh added.

Notably, Her comments mark a major turnaround. She had posted a series of videos lashing out at the CJP protesters for the language they used against leaders, including Prime Minister Narendra Modi. "Never in my life I have seen so much ugliness in one place, these reels from GenZ protests are puke inducing, the way they speak and the kind of language they are using, never in my life I have seen everything in each and every frame so jarring and so crass all at ones, ewwww who is birthing and raising them?" Kangana had shared.
As per the latest buzz, She also shared, "Here is a new generation of so-called westernised Indian women. I call them generation gutter."

In further updates, After videos from the NEET-related protests went widely shared, she shared the clips made her feel she needed “some healing” and a “digital detox.” Those remarks also generated considerable discussion online. “You call yourself cockroaches and look/behave like them as well... there is no paradox or juxtaposition there, just simply subjecting the world to your filth, garbage and ugliness. I am scarred from these reels, need some healing, digital detox,” the star had shared.

On top of that, On the work front, Kangana Ranaut’s latest venture has been the movie Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata , directed by Manoj Tapadia, based on the true story of the nurses and staff at Cama Hospital who saved the lives of patients during the 2008 Mumbai terrorist attacks.

title: Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata OTT release: When and where to watch Kangana Ranaut film, which collected only ₹8 crore
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata OTT rollout: Manoj Tapadia’s Kangana Ranaut -starrer Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata was rolled out in theatres on June 12 to favourable reviews but failed to make a mark at the ticket-window. The movie, based on the events of the 26/11 terror attacks, will soon stream online. Know when and where to watch it.

Adding to this, Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata OTT rollout: Kangana Ranaut played the lead and produced it. When and where to watch Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata will be available to stream on Zee5 from August 15. The OTT platform rolled out a new trailer to make the announcement on Friday, writing, “An untold story of ordinary nurses who stood with extraordinary courage on the darkest night of 26/11. Some heroes were never seen. Their stories were never told. Until now. Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata Trailer Out Now. #BharatBhhagyaViddhaata premieres on 14th Aug on Hindi Zee 5.”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Zee 5 (@zee5)

Notably, Talking about the movie, Kangana shared in a note, “Some stories choose you because they deserve to be told. Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata is one such movie. As both an star and producer, it was incredibly important for me to bring to life the untold stories of the healthcare workers who stood fearlessly between terror and humanity during the 26/11 attacks.”

As per the latest buzz, She also added, “Their courage wasn't driven by recognition, but by an unwavering sense of duty and compassion. Releasing this movie around Independence Day makes its message even more meaningful, as it reminds us that the spirit of India is defined not only by those who defend the nation on the frontlines, but also by ordinary citizens who rise to extraordinary challenges in moments of crisis.”

In further updates, “From the very beginning, our intention was to tell the story of 26/11 from a perspective that has never been explored. While the nation remembers the bravery of our security forces, there were equally extraordinary acts of courage unfolding inside Cama Hospital that night. Doctors, nurses and hospital staff continued to care for their patients despite the immense danger surrounding them,” shared Manoj.

On top of that, Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata is written and directed by Manoj Tapadia and produced by PEN Studios, Manikarnika Films and Paramhans Creations in association with Eunoia Films LLP and Floating Rocks Entertainment Pvt Ltd. It stars Kangana Ranaut alongside Girija Oak and Smita Tambe, among others. According to the trade website Sacnilk, the movie collected ₹ 7.04 crore rupees net in India and ₹ 8.32 crore rupees worldwide.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari on Friday morning visited veteran star and BJP leader Mithun Chakraborty at a private hospital in Kolkata, where he underwent a surgical procedure, sources at the medical establishment shared.

Adding to this, Mithun Chakraborty undergoes surgery. Mithun Chakraborty undergoes surgery Chakraborty underwent a procedure on Thursday to remove a metal plate that had been implanted following an incident. The procedure was successful and the star is in a stable condition, they shared.

If things proceed as planned, the movie can turn out to be the biggest global theatrical rollout for any Indian movie ever.

Adding to this, Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana could become the widest-rolled out Indian movie ever with 59,000 screens. A worldwide rollout on an unprecedented scale According to a report in trade tracker Sacnilk, t he producers have plans to launch this movie on more than 59,000 screens through their global theatrical launch. Sony Pictures is responsible for the international distribution of this movie and aims to rollout Ramayana: Part 1 on more than 50,000 screens globally . In India, the movie will be launched on roughly 9,000 screens.

Meanwhile, If all goes according to the plan, this massive number of screens will easily beat those of some recent Indian movies like Pushpa: The Rule, which had its worldwide rollout on approximately 12,000-13,000 screens, and RRR, which was launched on about 10,000-11,000 screens worldwide.

Notably, Ramayana may also surpass Hollywood blockbusters like James Cameron's Avatar: The Way of Water which was rolled out on almost 52,000 screens around the globe and went on to gross more than $2.33 billion at the global ticket-window. The movie will also be out in premium versions, including IMAX.

As per the latest buzz, The trailer of this movie was officially launched on July 30 at Brahma Muhurat. Launched in Hindi, Kannada, Telugu, Tamil, and Malayalam apart from English dub, this trailer managed to garner more than one billion cumulative views in just five days.

In further updates, Reacting to the response, Namit Malhotra told ANI, “The trailer was rolled out last week and I think it crossed over a billion views in five days, which is a great moment for India. I really appreciate all the love we've got from people all over the world. The aspiration is to now take it to the world as we are with our partnership with Sony Pictures. We are hoping to make sure that Ramayana now releases globally as a big universal movie.”

On top of that, Speaking about the story's universal appeal, he added, “Every Indian, every person in the world I feel can identify with it in some form and shape, so the fact that we're getting appreciation for it and it's connecting with people, that's a feeling of great satisfaction that we are on the right track.”

Produced by Prime Focus Studios and Monster Mind Creations, the movie stars Ranbir Kapoor (Lord Rama and Lord Parshurama), Sai Pallavi (Goddess Sita), Yash (Ravana), Sunny Deol (Lord Hanuman), Ravi Dubey (Lakshman), Lara Dutta (Queen Kaikeyi), Arun Govil (King Dasharath), Kajal Aggarwal (Mandodari), Rakul Preet Singh (Shurpanakha), Vivek Oberoi (Vidyutjihva), Kunal Kapoor (Lord Indra), Raghav Juyal (Meghanad), Sheeba Chaddha (Manthara), Indira Krishnan (Kaushalya), while Anupam Kher lends his voice to Jatayu.

title: Exclusive| Ranvir Shorey reacts to intense social media trolling: Have never misbehaved unless someone did it first
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Beginning Wednesday, the barrage of negativity surrounding star Ranvir Shorey refuses to slow down. It all started with a light-hearted reel featuring him dancing with his Khosla Ka Ghosla 2 co-stars Anupam Kher , Boman Irani and Parveen Dabas. It unexpectedly went widely shared, crossing a 100 million views on Instagram.

Adding to this, Ranvir Shorey An X user reposted it, and added a caption throwing shade at him. The star hit back with a crude remark, one which attracted the ire of social media immediately. Users accused him of misogyny because the profile carried a woman’s display picture.

Meanwhile, “There is no such reply on my timeline. I reply to trolls in the language they speak in, and I will not be apologetic about it. The user you are mentioning is a known toxic and abusive account, whose real gender and age are unknown to me. The kind of language that account uses is more important than if the profile picture is of a girl or boy. If girls can be gutter mouthed, then they should be ready to hear the same kind of replies too,” he tells us when we reach out to him.

Notably, The episode spiralled beyond the original exchange, with social media users digging up personal aspects of Shorey’s life and levelling allegations against him. Some went to the extent of saying his marriage with star Konkona Sen Sharma didn’t work out because of his behaviour.
As per the latest buzz, Another user alleged that they had spotted Ranvir being rude to a movie theatre staff member over a popcorn bucket.

In further updates, Dismissing them as “simply haters”, Shorey insists he has never initiated such behaviour, “Those are simply haters. This entire incident was triggered by the hate towards just a funny 15 second reel that I made with the KKG team that went hugely widely shared! I have never misbehaved with anyone unless they have misbehaved with me first. And I am under no moral, ethical or legal obligation to take any abuse or hate lying down. From men or women. I am done with this episode. I would rather think about the next reel.”

On top of that, Rishabh Suri writes for the daily Entertainment & Lifestyle supplement HT City. From Bollywood to Hollywood, from Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam films, to OTT and television- he covers it all.
